globals.armortable.bronze_scales_cover_t.source: Bronze scales cover the surface of treated leather, offering greater protection than plain leather with minimal additional weight.
globals.armortable.bronze_scales_cover_t.pattern: Bronze scales cover the surface of treated leather, offering greater protection than plain leather with minimal additional weight.
globals.armortable.bronze_scales_cover_t.text: 加工した革を青銅の鱗で覆った鎧。わずかな重量増で、革だけの鎧より高い防御力を得られる。

globals.armortable.enormous_plates_of_me.source: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.
globals.armortable.enormous_plates_of_me.pattern: Enormous plates of metal are joined together into a suit that provides unmatched protection to any adventurer strong enough to bear its staggering weight.
globals.armortable.enormous_plates_of_me.text: 巨大な金属板を組み合わせた鎧。驚くほどの重さに耐えられる冒険者には、比類ない防御力を与える。

globals.armortable.interlocking_metal_li.source: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.
globals.armortable.interlocking_metal_li.pattern: Interlocking metal links make for a tough but flexible suit of armor.
globals.armortable.interlocking_metal_li.text: 金属の輪を連結した、丈夫で柔軟な鎧。

globals.armortable.overlapping_strips_of.source: Overlapping strips of metal horizontally encircle a chain mail base, offering an additional layer of protection at the cost of greater weight.
globals.armortable.overlapping_strips_of.pattern: Overlapping strips of metal horizontally encircle a chain mail base, offering an additional layer of protection at the cost of greater weight.
globals.armortable.overlapping_strips_of.text: 鎖かたびらの周りを横向きに重ねた金属帯で囲む鎧。重さと引き換えに防御力を増す。

globals.armortable.thick_plates_of_metal.source: Thick plates of metal are embedded into a chain mail base, providing the wearer with substantial protection.
globals.armortable.thick_plates_of_metal.pattern: Thick plates of metal are embedded into a chain mail base, providing the wearer with substantial protection.
globals.armortable.thick_plates_of_metal.text: 鎖かたびらに厚い金属板を埋め込み、着用者を強固に守る鎧。

globals.armortable.this_lightweight_armo.source: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
globals.armortable.this_lightweight_armo.pattern: This lightweight armor offers basic protection.
globals.armortable.this_lightweight_armo.text: 最低限の防御力を備えた軽い鎧。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_cloud_of.source: a cloud of caustic gas sprays upward from the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_cloud_of.pattern: a cloud of caustic gas sprays upward from the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_cloud_of.text: 床から腐食性ガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_demonic_.source: a demonic presence whispers its demand: "Bring to me the marked sacrifice!"
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_demonic_.pattern: a demonic presence whispers its demand: "Bring to me the marked sacrifice!"
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_demonic_.text: 悪魔の気配が要求をささやく。「印の付いた生贄を連れてこい！」

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_net_fall.source: a net falls from the ceiling!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_net_fall.pattern: a net falls from the ceiling!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_net_fall.text: 天井から網が落ちてきた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_piercing.source: a piercing shriek echoes through the nearby rooms!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_piercing.pattern: a piercing shriek echoes through the nearby rooms!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_piercing.text: 鋭い叫びが近くの部屋に響いた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_scratchi.source: a scratching sound emanates from the nearby walls!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_scratchi.pattern: a scratching sound emanates from the nearby walls!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_scratchi.text: 近くの壁から引っかく音がする！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_sparklin.source: a sparkling cloud of confusion gas sprays upward from the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_sparklin.pattern: a sparkling cloud of confusion gas sprays upward from the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_sparklin.text: 床からきらめく混乱ガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_stone_br.source: a stone bridge extends from the floor with a grinding sound.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_stone_br.pattern: a stone bridge extends from the floor with a grinding sound.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_stone_br.text: 石橋がきしむ音を立てて床から伸びた。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_torch_fa.source: a torch falls from its mount and lies sputtering on the floor.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_torch_fa.pattern: a torch falls from its mount and lies sputtering on the floor.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.a_torch_fa.text: 松明が取り付け部から落ち、床でくすぶった。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.across_the.source: across the bog, bubbles rise ominously from the mud.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.across_the.pattern: across the bog, bubbles rise ominously from the mud.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.across_the.text: 沼の泥から不吉な泡が立ち上る。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.an_old_fri.source: An old friend emerges from a bloom of sacred light!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.an_old_fri.pattern: An old friend emerges from a bloom of sacred light!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.an_old_fri.text: 聖なる光の中から懐かしい友が現れた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.as_flames_.source: as flames begin to lick the coffin, its tenant bursts forth!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.as_flames_.pattern: as flames begin to lick the coffin, its tenant bursts forth!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.as_flames_.text: 棺に炎が迫ると、中の者が飛び出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.cracks_beg.source: cracks begin snaking across the marble surface of the statue!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.cracks_beg.pattern: cracks begin snaking across the marble surface of the statue!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.cracks_beg.text: 像の大理石の表面にひびが走り始めた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.deadly_pur.source: deadly purple gas starts wafting out of hidden vents in the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.deadly_pur.pattern: deadly purple gas starts wafting out of hidden vents in the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.deadly_pur.text: 床の隠れた穴から致命的な紫色のガスが漂い出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.demonic_ca.source: demonic cackling echoes through the room as the altar plunges downward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.demonic_ca.pattern: demonic cackling echoes through the room as the altar plunges downward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.demonic_ca.text: 祭壇が沈むと、悪魔の高笑いが部屋に響いた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.explosive_.source: explosive methane gas starts wafting out of hidden vents in the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.explosive_.pattern: explosive methane gas starts wafting out of hidden vents in the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.explosive_.text: 床の隠れた穴から爆発性のメタンガスが漂い出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.flames_qui.source: flames quickly consume the wooden barricade.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.flames_qui.pattern: flames quickly consume the wooden barricade.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.flames_qui.text: 炎が木の障壁をたちまち焼き尽くした。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.hissing_fi.source: hissing fills the air as the lava begins to cool.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.hissing_fi.pattern: hissing fills the air as the lava begins to cool.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.hissing_fi.text: 溶岩が冷え始め、空気に音が満ちた。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.paralytic_.source: paralytic gas sprays upward from hidden vents in the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.paralytic_.pattern: paralytic gas sprays upward from hidden vents in the floor!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.paralytic_.text: 床の隠れた穴から麻痺ガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.poisonous_.source: Poisonous spores burst from the corpse!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.poisonous_.pattern: Poisonous spores burst from the corpse!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.poisonous_.text: 死体から毒胞子が噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_altar_.source: the altar retracts into the ground with a grinding sound.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_altar_.pattern: the altar retracts into the ground with a grinding sound.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_altar_.text: 祭壇がきしむ音とともに地面へ引っ込んだ。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_archwa.source: the archway flashes, and you catch a glimpse of another world!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_archwa.pattern: the archway flashes, and you catch a glimpse of another world!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_archwa.text: アーチが輝き、別世界が一瞬見えた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_area_i.source: the area is flooded as water rises through imperceptible holes in the ground.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_area_i.pattern: the area is flooded as water rises through imperceptible holes in the ground.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_area_i.text: 地面の見えない穴から水が上がり、周囲が浸水した。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cage_l.source: the cage lifts off of the altar.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cage_l.pattern: the cage lifts off of the altar.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cage_l.text: 祭壇から檻が持ち上がった。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cages_.source: the cages lift off of the altars as you approach.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cages_.pattern: the cages lift off of the altars as you approach.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cages_.text: 近づくと、祭壇から檻が持ち上がった。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cages_.source: the cages lower to cover the altars.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cages_.pattern: the cages lower to cover the altars.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_cages_.text: 檻が下りて祭壇を覆った。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_coffin.source: the coffin opens and a dark figure rises!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_coffin.pattern: the coffin opens and a dark figure rises!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_coffin.text: 棺が開き、暗い人影が起き上がった！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_corpse.source: The corpse detonates with terrifying force!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_corpse.pattern: The corpse detonates with terrifying force!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_corpse.text: 死体が恐ろしい力で爆発した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_crysta.source: the crystal absorbs the electricity and begins to glow.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_crysta.pattern: the crystal absorbs the electricity and begins to glow.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_crysta.text: 水晶が電気を吸収し、光り始めた。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.source: the dewar shatters and pressurized caustic gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.pattern: the dewar shatters and pressurized caustic gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.text: 断熱容器が砕け、圧縮された腐食性ガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.source: the dewar shatters and pressurized confusion gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.pattern: the dewar shatters and pressurized confusion gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.text: 断熱容器が砕け、圧縮された混乱ガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.source: the dewar shatters and pressurized methane gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.pattern: the dewar shatters and pressurized methane gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.text: 断熱容器が砕け、圧縮されたメタンガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.source: the dewar shatters and pressurized paralytic gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.pattern: the dewar shatters and pressurized paralytic gas explodes outward!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_dewar_.text: 断熱容器が砕け、圧縮された麻痺ガスが噴き出した！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_glyph_.source: the glyph beneath you glows, and the guardians take a step!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_glyph_.pattern: the glyph beneath you glows, and the guardians take a step!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_glyph_.text: 足元の紋様が輝き、守護者たちが一歩進んだ！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_items_.source: the items on the two altars flash with a brilliant light!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_items_.pattern: the items on the two altars flash with a brilliant light!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_items_.text: 二つの祭壇のアイテムがまばゆく輝いた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_light_.source: the light in the room flickers and you feel a chill in the air.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_light_.pattern: the light in the room flickers and you feel a chill in the air.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_light_.text: 部屋の光が揺らめき、空気が冷たく感じられた。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_mirror.source: the mirrored totem flashes, reflecting the red glow of the glyph beneath you.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_mirror.pattern: the mirrored totem flashes, reflecting the red glow of the glyph beneath you.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_mirror.text: 鏡のトーテムが輝き、足元の紋様の赤い光を反射した。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_nearby.source: the nearby wall cracks and collapses in a cloud of dust!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_nearby.pattern: the nearby wall cracks and collapses in a cloud of dust!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_nearby.text: 近くの壁が割れ、土煙とともに崩れた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_nearby.source: the nearby wall explodes in a shower of stone fragments!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_nearby.pattern: the nearby wall explodes in a shower of stone fragments!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_nearby.text: 近くの壁が爆発し、石片が飛び散った！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_portcu.source: the portcullis slowly rises from the ground into a slot in the ceiling.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_portcu.pattern: the portcullis slowly rises from the ground into a slot in the ceiling.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_portcu.text: 落とし格子が地面からゆっくり上がり、天井の溝に入った。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_rope_b.source: the rope bridge snaps from the heat and plunges into the chasm!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_rope_b.pattern: the rope bridge snaps from the heat and plunges into the chasm!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_rope_b.text: 縄橋が熱で切れ、深淵に落ちた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_wall_a.source: the wall above the lever shifts to reveal a spark turret!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_wall_a.pattern: the wall above the lever shifts to reveal a spark turret!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.the_wall_a.text: レバーの上の壁が動き、電撃砲台が現れた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.with_a_hea.source: with a heavy mechanical sound, an iron portcullis falls from the ceiling!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.with_a_hea.pattern: with a heavy mechanical sound, an iron portcullis falls from the ceiling!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.with_a_hea.text: 重い機械音とともに、鉄の落とし格子が天井から落ちた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.source: you hear a click, and the stones in the wall shift to reveal turrets!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.pattern: you hear a click, and the stones in the wall shift to reveal turrets!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.text: カチリと音がし、壁の石が動いて砲台が現れた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.source: you hear a deep rumbling noise as the floor begins to collapse!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.pattern: you hear a deep rumbling noise as the floor begins to collapse!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.text: 深い轟音がして、床が崩れ始めた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.source: you hear a heavy click, and the nearby water begins flooding the area!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.pattern: you hear a heavy click, and the nearby water begins flooding the area!
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_hear_a.text: 大きな作動音がし、近くの水が周囲にあふれ始めた！

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_notice.source: you notice a lever hidden behind a loose stone in the wall.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_notice.pattern: you notice a lever hidden behind a loose stone in the wall.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_notice.text: 壁の緩んだ石の裏に隠れたレバーを見つけた。

globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_notice.source: you notice an inactive gas vent hidden in a crevice of the floor.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_notice.pattern: you notice an inactive gas vent hidden in a crevice of the floor.
globals.dungeonfeaturecatalog.you_notice.text: 床の裂け目に隠れた休止中のガス穴を見つけた。

globals.foodtable.a_ration_of_food_was_i.source: A ration of food. Was it left by former adventurers? Is it a curious byproduct of the subterranean ecosystem?
globals.foodtable.a_ration_of_food_was_i.pattern: A ration of food. Was it left by former adventurers? Is it a curious byproduct of the subterranean ecosystem?
globals.foodtable.a_ration_of_food_was_i.text: 一食分の食料。以前の冒険者が残したのか、地下の生態系が生む奇妙な副産物なのか？

globals.foodtable.an_odd_fruit_to_be_fou.source: An odd fruit to be found so deep beneath the surface of the earth, but only slightly less filling than a ration of food.
globals.foodtable.an_odd_fruit_to_be_fou.pattern: An odd fruit to be found so deep beneath the surface of the earth, but only slightly less filling than a ration of food.
globals.foodtable.an_odd_fruit_to_be_fou.text: 地中深くにあるのは不思議な果物。一食分の食料より少し腹持ちが悪い。

globals.keytable.a_faceted_orb_seemingly.source: A faceted orb, seemingly cut from a single crystal, sparkling and perpetually warm to the touch. What manner of device might such an object activate?
globals.keytable.a_faceted_orb_seemingly.pattern: A faceted orb, seemingly cut from a single crystal, sparkling and perpetually warm to the touch. What manner of device might such an object activate?
globals.keytable.a_faceted_orb_seemingly.text: 一つの水晶から切り出したような多面体の球。きらめき、触れると常に温かい。どんな装置を作動させるものだろう？

globals.keytable.the_notches_on_this_anc.source: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?
globals.keytable.the_notches_on_this_anc.pattern: The notches on this ancient iron key are well worn; its leather lanyard is battered by age. What door might it open?
globals.keytable.the_notches_on_this_anc.text: 古い鉄の鍵の溝は摩耗し、革紐も年月で傷んでいる。どの扉を開くのだろう？

globals.keytable.the_rust_accreted_on_th.source: The rust accreted on this iron key has been stained with flecks of blood; it must have been used recently. What cage might it open?
globals.keytable.the_rust_accreted_on_th.pattern: The rust accreted on this iron key has been stained with flecks of blood; it must have been used recently. What cage might it open?
globals.keytable.the_rust_accreted_on_th.text: 鉄の鍵に積もった錆には血が付いている。最近使われたようだ。どの檻を開くのだろう？

globals.monstertext.a_bladder_of_deadly_.source: A bladder of deadly gas buoys the bloat through the air, $HISHER thin veinous membrane ready to rupture at the slightest stress.

globals.monstertext.a_creature_of_inchoa.source: A creature of inchoate rage made flesh, the fury's moist wings beat loudly in the darkness.
globals.monstertext.a_creature_of_inchoa.pattern: A creature of inchoate rage made flesh, the fury's moist wings beat loudly in the darkness.

globals.monstertext.a_filthy_little_prim.pattern: A filthy little primate, the tribalistic goblin often travels in packs and carries a makeshift stone spear.

globals.monstertext.a_naked_adventurer_i.source: A naked adventurer in an unforgiving place, bereft of equipment and confused about the circumstances.
globals.monstertext.a_naked_adventurer_i.pattern: A naked adventurer in an unforgiving place, bereft of equipment and confused about the circumstances.
globals.monstertext.a_naked_adventurer_i.text: 装備を失い、状況もわからず、過酷な場所にいる裸の冒険者。

globals.monstertext.a_prism_of_shoulder_.source: A prism of shoulder-high mirrored surfaces gleams in the darkness.
globals.monstertext.a_prism_of_shoulder_.pattern: A prism of shoulder-high mirrored surfaces gleams in the darkness.
globals.monstertext.a_prism_of_shoulder_.text: 肩ほどの高さの鏡面の角柱が闇で輝いている。

globals.monstertext.a_serpent_wreathed_i.source: A serpent wreathed in flames and carrying a burning lash, salamanders dwell in lakes of fire and emerge when they sense a nearby victim, leaving behind a trail of glowing embers.

globals.monstertext.a_silhouette_of_mour.source: A silhouette of mournful rage against an empty backdrop, the phantom slips through the dungeon invisibly in clear air, leaving behind glowing droplets of ectoplasm and the cries of $HISHER unsuspecting victims.

globals.monstertext.a_silhouette_of_mour.text: 空虚を背にした悲しい怒りの影。ファントムは見えないまま迷宮を進み、光る霊質の滴と、無防備な犠牲者の悲鳴を残す。

globals.monstertext.a_spectral_outline_o.pattern: A spectral outline of a knight carrying a battleaxe casts an ethereal light on {0} surroundings.
globals.monstertext.a_spectral_outline_o.text: 戦斧を持つ騎士の幻影が、周囲に幽玄な光を投げかける。

globals.monstertext.a_statue_animated_by.source: A statue animated by an ancient and tireless magic, the golem does not regenerate and attacks with only moderate strength, but $HISHER stone form can withstand incredible damage before collapsing into rubble.

globals.monstertext.a_statue_of_a_sword_.source: A statue of a sword-wielding angel surveys the room, connected to the glowing glyphs on the floor by invisible strands of enchantment.
globals.monstertext.a_statue_of_a_sword_.pattern: A statue of a sword-wielding angel surveys the room, connected to the glowing glyphs on the floor by invisible strands of enchantment.

globals.monstertext.a_strange_and_horrif.source: A strange and horrifying creature of the earth's deepest places, larger than an ogre but capable of squeezing through tiny openings. When hungry, the underworm will burrow behind the walls of a cavern and lurk dormant and motionless -- often for months -- until $HESHE can feel the telltale vibrations of nearby prey.
globals.monstertext.a_strange_and_horrif.pattern: A strange and horrifying creature of the earth's deepest places, larger than an ogre but capable of squeezing through tiny openings. When hungry, the underworm will burrow behind the walls of a cavern and lurk dormant and motionless -- often for months -- until {0} can feel the telltale vibrations of nearby prey.
globals.monstertext.a_strange_and_horrif.text: 地の最深部の奇怪で恐ろしい生物。オーガより大きいが、小さな隙間も通れる。空腹のアンダーワームは洞窟の壁に潜り、獲物の振動を感じるまで何か月も動かず潜伏する。

globals.monstertext.a_tiny_humanoid_spar.source: A tiny humanoid sparkles in the gloom, the hum of $HISHER beating wings punctuated by intermittent peals of high-pitched laughter. What $HESHE lacks in physical endurance, $HESHE makes up for with $HISHER wealth of mischievous magical abilities.

globals.monstertext.a_whirling_desert_st.source: A whirling desert storm given human shape, the ifrit's twin scimitars flicker in the darkness and $HISHER eyes burn with otherworldly zeal.

globals.monstertext.an_ancient_serpent_o.source: An ancient serpent of the world's deepest places, the dragon's immense form belies its lightning-quick speed and testifies to $HISHER breathtaking strength. An undying furnace of white-hot flames burns within $HISHER scaly hide, and few could withstand a single moment under $HISHER infernal lash.
globals.monstertext.an_ancient_serpent_o.pattern: An ancient serpent of the world's deepest places, the dragon's immense form belies its lightning-quick speed and testifies to {0} breathtaking strength. An undying furnace of white-hot flames burns within {1} scaly hide, and few could withstand a single moment under {2} infernal lash.
globals.monstertext.an_ancient_serpent_o.text: 世界の最深部の古い大蛇。巨大なドラゴンは意外にも電光の速さで動き、驚異的な力を誇る。鱗の内側で白熱する炉が燃え続け、その業火に一瞬でも耐えられる者は少ない。

globals.monstertext.an_ancient_statue_of.source: An ancient statue of an unrecognizable humanoid figure, the sentinel holds aloft a crystal that gleams with ancient warding magic. Sentinels are always found in groups, and each will attempt to repair any damage done to the others.

globals.monstertext.an_elemental_creatur.source: An elemental creature from another plane of existence, the infernal flamedancer burns with such intensity that $HESHE is painful to behold.
globals.monstertext.an_elemental_creatur.pattern: An elemental creature from another plane of existence, the infernal flamedancer burns with such intensity that {0} is painful to behold.

globals.monstertext.an_enormous_disfigur.source: An enormous, disfigured creature covered in phlegm and warts, the troll regenerates very quickly and attacks with astonishing strength. Many adventures have ended at $HISHER misshapen hands.

globals.monstertext.an_ethereal_blue_fla.source: An ethereal blue flame dances through the air, flickering and pulsing in time to an otherworldly rhythm.
globals.monstertext.an_ethereal_blue_fla.pattern: An ethereal blue flame dances through the air, flickering and pulsing in time to an otherworldly rhythm.

globals.monstertext.an_immortal_presence.source: An immortal presence stalks through the dungeon, implacably hunting that which was taken... and the one who took it.

globals.monstertext.ancient_ogres_versed.source: Ancient ogres versed in the eldritch arts have assembled this totem and imbued $HIMHER with occult power.

globals.monstertext.bursts_as_a_newborn_.source: bursts as a newborn phoenix rises from the ashes!

globals.monstertext.chants_in_a_harsh_gu.source: chants in a harsh, guttural tongue!

globals.monstertext.crackles_with_energy.source: crackles with energy as you touch the glyph!

globals.monstertext.cradled_in_a_nest_of.source: Cradled in a nest of cooling ashes, the translucent membrane of the phoenix egg reveals a yolk that glows brighter by the second.

globals.monstertext.cradled_in_a_nest_of.text: 冷える灰の巣に抱かれた不死鳥の卵。半透明の膜の中の黄身は、刻々と輝きを増している。

globals.monstertext.detonates_with_terri.text: 恐ろしい力で爆発した！

globals.monstertext.eldritch_energies_bo.source: Eldritch energies bound up in your equipment have leapt forth to project this spectral image.

globals.monstertext.eldritch_energies_bo.text: 装備に宿る妖しい力が飛び出し、この幻影を映し出した。

globals.monstertext.eldritch_forces_have.source: Eldritch forces have coalesced to form this flickering, ethereal weapon.
globals.monstertext.eldritch_forces_have.pattern: Eldritch forces have coalesced to form this flickering, ethereal weapon.
globals.monstertext.eldritch_forces_have.text: 妖しい力が凝縮し、揺らめく幽玄な武器となった。

globals.monstertext.goblins_have_created.source: Goblins have created this makeshift totem and imbued $HIMHER with a shamanistic power.
globals.monstertext.goblins_have_created.pattern: Goblins have created this makeshift totem and imbued {0} with a shamanistic power.
globals.monstertext.goblins_have_created.text: ゴブリンたちは粗末なトーテムを作り、呪術の力を込めた。

globals.monstertext.guarding_the_room_is.source: Guarding the room is a weathered stone statue of a knight carrying a battleaxe, connected to the glowing glyphs on the floor by invisible strands of enchantment.

globals.monstertext.half_man_and_half_ho.source: Half man and half horse, the centaur is an expert with the bow and arrow -- hunter and steed fused into a single creature.

globals.monstertext.often_hunting_in_pac.source: Often hunting in packs, leathery wings and keen senses guide the vampire bat unerringly to $HISHER prey.

globals.monstertext.rasps_a_terrifying_i.text: 恐ろしい呪文をかすれ声で唱えた！

globals.monstertext.spreads_his_cloak_an.source: spreads his cloak and bursts into a cloud of bats!
globals.monstertext.spreads_his_cloak_an.pattern: spreads his cloak and bursts into a cloud of bats!
globals.monstertext.spreads_his_cloak_an.text: 外套を広げ、コウモリの群れに変わった！

globals.monstertext.swirls_with_dark_sor.source: swirls with dark sorcery as the lich regenerates its form!
globals.monstertext.swirls_with_dark_sor.pattern: swirls with dark sorcery as the lich regenerates its form!
globals.monstertext.swirls_with_dark_sor.text: リッチが姿を再生すると、闇の魔力が渦巻いた！

globals.monstertext.taller_stronger_and_.source: Taller, stronger and smarter than other goblins, the warlord commands the loyalty of $HISHER kind and can summon them into battle.

globals.monstertext.the_acid_mound_squel.source: The acid mound squelches softly across the ground, leaving a trail of hissing goo in $HISHER path.

globals.monstertext.the_dar_battlemage_s.source: The dar battlemage's eyes glow like embers and $HISHER hands radiate an occult heat.

globals.monstertext.the_dar_battlemage_s.text: ダールの戦闘魔術師の目は炭火のように輝き、手から秘術の熱を放つ。

globals.monstertext.the_dar_priestess_ca.source: The dar priestess carries a host of religious relics that jangle as $HESHE walks.

globals.monstertext.the_dar_priestess_ca.text: ダールの女祭司は多数の聖遺物を持ち、歩くたびに音を鳴らす。

globals.monstertext.the_eel_slips_silent.source: The eel slips silently through the subterranean lake, waiting for unsuspecting prey to set foot in $HISHER dark waters.

globals.monstertext.the_enormous_warty_t.source: The enormous, warty toad secretes a powerful hallucinogenic slime to befuddle the senses of any creatures that come in contact with $HIMHER.

globals.monstertext.the_enormous_warty_t.text: 巨大でいぼだらけのヒキガエル。接触した生物の感覚を狂わせる、強力な幻覚性の粘液を分泌する。

globals.monstertext.the_horrifying_bog_m.source: The horrifying bog monster dwells beneath the surface of mud-filled swamps. When $HISHER prey ventures into the mud, the bog monster will ensnare the unsuspecting victim in $HISHER pale tentacles and squeeze its life away.
globals.monstertext.the_horrifying_bog_m.pattern: The horrifying bog monster dwells beneath the surface of mud-filled swamps. When {0} prey ventures into the mud, the bog monster will ensnare the unsuspecting victim in {1} pale tentacles and squeeze its life away.
globals.monstertext.the_horrifying_bog_m.text: 恐ろしい沼の怪物は泥沼の下に潜む。獲物が泥に入ると、青白い触手で捕らえて命を絞り取る。

globals.monstertext.the_jackal_prowls_th.source: The jackal prowls the caverns for intruders to rend with $HISHER powerful jaws.
globals.monstertext.the_jackal_prowls_th.pattern: The jackal prowls the caverns for intruders to rend with {0} powerful jaws.
globals.monstertext.the_jackal_prowls_th.text: ジャッカルは洞窟をうろつき、侵入者を強い顎で引き裂こうとする。

globals.monstertext.the_kobold_is_a_liza.source: The kobold is a lizardlike humanoid of the upper dungeon.
globals.monstertext.the_kobold_is_a_liza.pattern: The kobold is a lizardlike humanoid of the upper dungeon.
globals.monstertext.the_kobold_is_a_liza.text: コボルドは迷宮の浅い階に住む、トカゲに似た人型の生物。

globals.monstertext.the_rat_is_a_scaveng.source: The rat is a scavenger of the shallows, perpetually in search of decaying animal matter.
globals.monstertext.the_rat_is_a_scaveng.pattern: The rat is a scavenger of the shallows, perpetually in search of decaying animal matter.
globals.monstertext.the_rat_is_a_scaveng.text: ネズミは浅い階の腐肉食動物で、絶えず腐った動物の肉を探す。

globals.monstertext.the_serpentine_naga_.source: The serpentine naga live beneath the subterranean waters and emerge to attack unsuspecting adventurers.
globals.monstertext.the_serpentine_naga_.pattern: The serpentine naga live beneath the subterranean waters and emerge to attack unsuspecting adventurers.
globals.monstertext.the_serpentine_naga_.text: 蛇身のナーガは地下の水に住み、不意を突いて冒険者を攻撃する。

globals.monstertext.the_spider_s_red_eye.source: The spider's red eyes pierce the darkness in search of enemies to ensnare with $HISHER projectile webs and dissolve with deadly poison.
globals.monstertext.the_spider_s_red_eye.pattern: The spider's red eyes pierce the darkness in search of enemies to ensnare with {0} projectile webs and dissolve with deadly poison.
globals.monstertext.the_spider_s_red_eye.text: 蜘蛛は赤い目で闇を見通し、敵を飛ばした糸で捕らえ、致命的な毒で溶かそうとする。

globals.monstertext.the_unicorn_s_flowin.source: The unicorn's flowing mane and tail shine with rainbow light, $HISHER horn glows with healing and protective magic, and $HISHER eyes implore you to always chase your dreams. Unicorns are rumored to be attracted to virgins -- is there a hint of accusation in $HISHER gaze?
globals.monstertext.the_unicorn_s_flowin.pattern: The unicorn's flowing mane and tail shine with rainbow light, {0} horn glows with healing and protective magic, and {1} eyes implore you to always chase your dreams. Unicorns are rumored to be attracted to virgins -- is there a hint of accusation in {2} gaze?
globals.monstertext.the_unicorn_s_flowin.text: ユニコーンの流れる鬣と尾は虹色に輝き、角は治癒と保護の魔法で光る。目は夢を追うよう訴える。処女に惹かれるという噂だが、その視線には非難の色があるのだろうか？

globals.monstertext.the_wraith_s_hollow_.source: The wraith's hollow eye sockets stare hungrily at the world from $HISHER emaciated frame, and $HISHER long, bloodstained nails grope ceaselessly at the air for a fresh victim.
globals.monstertext.the_wraith_s_hollow_.pattern: The wraith's hollow eye sockets stare hungrily at the world from {0} emaciated frame, and {1} long, bloodstained nails grope ceaselessly at the air for a fresh victim.
globals.monstertext.the_wraith_s_hollow_.text: レイスの空の眼窩は痩せた体から世界を飢えた目で見つめ、血に染まった長い爪で新たな犠牲者を絶えず探す。

globals.monstertext.the_zombie_is_the_ac.source: The zombie is the accursed product of a long-forgotten ritual. Perpetually decaying flesh hangs from $HISHER bones in shreds and releases a flammable stench that will induce violent nausea with one whiff.
globals.monstertext.the_zombie_is_the_ac.pattern: The zombie is the accursed product of a long-forgotten ritual. Perpetually decaying flesh hangs from {0} bones in shreds and releases a flammable stench that will induce violent nausea with one whiff.
globals.monstertext.the_zombie_is_the_ac.text: ゾンビは忘れられた儀式の呪われた産物。腐り続ける肉が骨から垂れ下がり、一嗅ぎで激しい吐き気を起こす可燃性の悪臭を放つ。

globals.monstertext.this_blob_of_jet_bla.source: This blob of jet-black goo is as rare as $HESHE is deadly. Few creatures of the dungeon can withstand $HISHER caustic assault. Beware.
globals.monstertext.this_blob_of_jet_bla.pattern: This blob of jet-black goo is as rare as {0} is deadly. Few creatures of the dungeon can withstand {1} caustic assault. Beware.
globals.monstertext.this_blob_of_jet_bla.text: この漆黒の粘液の塊は、致命的なほどに珍しい。迷宮の生物でもその腐食攻撃に耐えるものは少ない。注意せよ。

globals.monstertext.this_contraption_hum.source: This contraption hums with electrical charge that $HISHER embedded crystals and magical sigils can direct at intruders in deadly arcs.
globals.monstertext.this_contraption_hum.pattern: This contraption hums with electrical charge that {0} embedded crystals and magical sigils can direct at intruders in deadly arcs.
globals.monstertext.this_contraption_hum.text: この機械は電気を帯びてうなる。埋め込まれた水晶と魔法の印は、侵入者に致命的な電弧を放つ。

globals.monstertext.this_gem_was_the_ful.source: This gem was the fulcrum of a dark rite, performed centuries ago, that bound the soul of an ancient and terrible sorcerer. Hurry and destroy the gem, before the lich can gather its power and regenerate its corporeal form!
globals.monstertext.this_gem_was_the_ful.pattern: This gem was the fulcrum of a dark rite, performed centuries ago, that bound the soul of an ancient and terrible sorcerer. Hurry and destroy the gem, before the lich can gather its power and regenerate its corporeal form!
globals.monstertext.this_gem_was_the_ful.text: 何世紀も前に行われた闇の儀式で、恐ろしい古代魔術師の魂を縛った宝石。リッチが力を集めて肉体を再生する前に、急いで破壊せよ！

globals.monstertext.this_goblin_carries_.source: This goblin carries no weapon, and $HISHER eyes sparkle with golden light. $HESHE can invoke a powerful shielding magic to protect $HISHER escorts from harm.
globals.monstertext.this_goblin_carries_.pattern: This goblin carries no weapon, and {0} eyes sparkle with golden light. {1} can invoke a powerful shielding magic to protect {2} escorts from harm.
globals.monstertext.this_goblin_carries_.text: このゴブリンは武器を持たず、目が黄金に輝く。強力な盾の魔法を唱え、同行者を守れる。

globals.monstertext.this_goblin_is_cover.source: This goblin is covered with glowing sigils that pulse with power. $HESHE can call into existence phantom blades to attack $HISHER foes.
globals.monstertext.this_goblin_is_cover.pattern: This goblin is covered with glowing sigils that pulse with power. {0} can call into existence phantom blades to attack {1} foes.
globals.monstertext.this_goblin_is_cover.text: このゴブリンは力強く脈打つ紋様に覆われる。幻影の刃を生み出し、敵を攻撃できる。

globals.monstertext.this_infernal_contra.source: This infernal contraption spits blasts of flame at intruders.
globals.monstertext.this_infernal_contra.pattern: This infernal contraption spits blasts of flame at intruders.
globals.monstertext.this_infernal_contra.text: この地獄の機械は侵入者に炎を噴きかける。

globals.monstertext.this_legendary_bird_.source: This legendary bird shines with a brilliant light, and $HISHER wings crackle and pop like embers as they beat the air. When $HESHE dies, legend has it that an egg will form and a newborn phoenix will rise from its ashes.
globals.monstertext.this_legendary_bird_.pattern: This legendary bird shines with a brilliant light, and {0} wings crackle and pop like embers as they beat the air. When {1} dies, legend has it that an egg will form and a newborn phoenix will rise from its ashes.
globals.monstertext.this_legendary_bird_.text: 伝説の鳥はまばゆく輝き、翼を動かすと燃えさしのような音を立てる。死ぬと卵が生まれ、灰から新しい不死鳥が現れるという。

globals.monstertext.this_lumbering_creat.source: This lumbering creature carries an enormous club that $HESHE can swing with incredible force.
globals.monstertext.this_lumbering_creat.pattern: This lumbering creature carries an enormous club that {0} can swing with incredible force.
globals.monstertext.this_lumbering_creat.text: のろのろ歩くこの生物は、巨大な棍棒を驚く力で振るう。

globals.monstertext.this_mangrove_dryad_.source: This mangrove dryad is as old as the earth, and $HISHER gnarled figure houses an ancient power. When angered, $HESHE can call upon the forces of nature to bind $HISHER foes and tear them to shreds.
globals.monstertext.this_mangrove_dryad_.pattern: This mangrove dryad is as old as the earth, and {0} gnarled figure houses an ancient power. When angered, {1} can call upon the forces of nature to bind {2} foes and tear them to shreds.
globals.monstertext.this_mangrove_dryad_.text: 大地ほど古いマングローブのドリュアス。節くれだった体に古い力が宿る。怒ると自然の力を呼び、敵を縛って引き裂く。

globals.monstertext.this_mass_of_caustic.source: This mass of caustic pink goo slips across the ground in search of a warm meal.
globals.monstertext.this_mass_of_caustic.pattern: This mass of caustic pink goo slips across the ground in search of a warm meal.
globals.monstertext.this_mass_of_caustic.text: この腐食性の桃色の粘液は、温かい食事を探して地面を這う。

globals.monstertext.this_monstrous_centi.source: This monstrous centipede's incisors are imbued with a horrible venom that will slowly kill $HISHER prey.
globals.monstertext.this_monstrous_centi.pattern: This monstrous centipede's incisors are imbued with a horrible venom that will slowly kill {0} prey.
globals.monstertext.this_monstrous_centi.text: この巨大な百足の牙には、獲物をゆっくり死に至らせる恐ろしい毒がある。

globals.monstertext.this_ogre_is_bent_wi.source: This ogre is bent with age, but what $HESHE has lost in physical strength, $HESHE has more than gained in occult power.
globals.monstertext.this_ogre_is_bent_wi.pattern: This ogre is bent with age, but what {0} has lost in physical strength, {1} has more than gained in occult power.
globals.monstertext.this_ogre_is_bent_wi.text: 年老いて腰が曲がったオーガ。肉体の強さは失われたが、それ以上の秘術の力を得ている。

globals.monstertext.this_rare_subspecies.source: This rare subspecies of bloat is filled with a peculiar vapor that, if released, will cause the floor to vanish out from underneath $HIMHER.
globals.monstertext.this_rare_subspecies.pattern: This rare subspecies of bloat is filled with a peculiar vapor that, if released, will cause the floor to vanish out from underneath {0}.
globals.monstertext.this_rare_subspecies.text: ブロートの珍しい亜種。放出されると下の床を消す、奇妙な蒸気に満ちている。

globals.monstertext.this_rare_subspecies.source: This rare subspecies of bloat is little more than a thin membrane surrounding a bladder of highly explosive gases. The slightest stress will cause $HIMHER to rupture in spectacular and deadly fashion.
globals.monstertext.this_rare_subspecies.pattern: This rare subspecies of bloat is little more than a thin membrane surrounding a bladder of highly explosive gases. The slightest stress will cause {0} to rupture in spectacular and deadly fashion.
globals.monstertext.this_rare_subspecies.text: ブロートの珍しい亜種。極めて爆発しやすいガスを薄い膜が覆う。わずかな力で派手かつ致命的に破裂する。

globals.monstertext.this_seething_toweri.source: This seething, towering nightmare of fleshy tentacles slinks through the bowels of the world. The tentacle horror's incredible strength and regeneration make $HIMHER one of the most fearsome creatures of the dungeon.
globals.monstertext.this_seething_toweri.pattern: This seething, towering nightmare of fleshy tentacles slinks through the bowels of the world. The tentacle horror's incredible strength and regeneration make {0} one of the most fearsome creatures of the dungeon.
globals.monstertext.this_seething_toweri.text: 蠢く肉の触手からなる巨大な悪夢が、世界の奥底を這う。触手の怪物の驚異的な力と再生能力は、迷宮でも最も恐ろしい部類に入る。

globals.monstertext.this_spring_loaded_c.source: This spring-loaded contraption fires darts that are imbued with a strength-sapping poison.
globals.monstertext.this_spring_loaded_c.pattern: This spring-loaded contraption fires darts that are imbued with a strength-sapping poison.
globals.monstertext.this_spring_loaded_c.text: このばね仕掛けの機械は、筋力を奪う毒を塗った投げ矢を放つ。

globals.monstertext.this_tentacled_night.source: This tentacled nightmare will emerge from the subterranean waters to ensnare and devour any creature foolish enough to set foot into $HISHER lake.
globals.monstertext.this_tentacled_night.pattern: This tentacled nightmare will emerge from the subterranean waters to ensnare and devour any creature foolish enough to set foot into {0} lake.
globals.monstertext.this_tentacled_night.text: この触手の悪夢は地下の水から現れ、湖に踏み込む愚かな生物を捕らえて貪る。

globals.monstertext.this_totem_sits_at_t.source: This totem sits at the center of a summoning circle that radiates a strange energy.
globals.monstertext.this_totem_sits_at_t.pattern: This totem sits at the center of a summoning circle that radiates a strange energy.
globals.monstertext.this_totem_sits_at_t.text: このトーテムは、奇妙な力を放つ召喚陣の中央に立つ。

globals.monstertext.this_trickster_demon.source: This trickster demon moves with astonishing speed and delights in stealing from $HISHER enemies and blinking away.
globals.monstertext.this_trickster_demon.pattern: This trickster demon moves with astonishing speed and delights in stealing from {0} enemies and blinking away.
globals.monstertext.this_trickster_demon.text: このいたずら好きの悪魔は驚く速さで動き、敵の持ち物を盗んで瞬間移動するのを楽しむ。

globals.monstertext.this_unholy_specter_.source: This unholy specter stalks the deep places of the earth without fear, impervious to conventional attacks.
globals.monstertext.this_unholy_specter_.pattern: This unholy specter stalks the deep places of the earth without fear, impervious to conventional attacks.
globals.monstertext.this_unholy_specter_.text: この邪悪な幽霊は、普通の攻撃に傷つくことなく、地の深い場所を恐れず歩く。

globals.monstertext.this_vampire_lives_a.source: This vampire lives a solitary life deep underground, consuming any warm-blooded creature unfortunate enough to venture near $HISHER lair.
globals.monstertext.this_vampire_lives_a.pattern: This vampire lives a solitary life deep underground, consuming any warm-blooded creature unfortunate enough to venture near {0} lair.
globals.monstertext.this_vampire_lives_a.text: この吸血鬼は地下深くで孤独に暮らし、住処に近づいた不運な温血動物を食らう。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation allows $HIMHER to heal $HIMSELFHERSELF with every attack.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation allows {0} to heal {1} with every attack.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異により、攻撃のたびに自身を治癒する。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation causes $HIMHER to poison $HISHER victims and sap their strength with every attack.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation causes {0} to poison {1} victims and sap their strength with every attack.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異により、攻撃のたびに獲物を毒で侵し、筋力を奪う。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation greatly enhances $HISHER mobility.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation greatly enhances {0} mobility.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異により、機動力が大幅に高まった。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation has caused suckered tentacles to sprout from $HISHER frame, increasing $HISHER health and allowing $HIMHER to grapple with $HISHER prey.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation has caused suckered tentacles to sprout from {0} frame, increasing {1} health and allowing {2} to grapple with {3} prey.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異で体から吸盤のある触手が生え、体力が増して獲物を捕まえられるようになった。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation has coated $HISHER flesh with reflective scales.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation has coated {0} flesh with reflective scales.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異により、体が反射する鱗に覆われた。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation has hardened $HISHER flesh, increasing $HISHER health and power but compromising $HISHER speed.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation has hardened {0} flesh, increasing {1} health and power but compromising {2} speed.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異により体が硬くなり、体力と攻撃力が増したが、速さは失われた。

globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.source: A rare mutation will cause $HIMHER to explode violently when $HESHE dies.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.pattern: A rare mutation will cause {0} to explode violently when {1} dies.
globals.mutationcatalog.a_rare_mutation_.text: 珍しい変異により、死ぬと激しく爆発する。

globals.mutationcatalog.heshe_has_been_i.source: $HESHE has been infested by deadly lichen spores; poisonous fungus will spread from $HISHER corpse when $HESHE dies.
globals.mutationcatalog.heshe_has_been_i.pattern: {0} has been infested by deadly lichen spores; poisonous fungus will spread from {1} corpse when {2} dies.
globals.mutationcatalog.heshe_has_been_i.text: 致命的な地衣の胞子に寄生され、死ぬと死体から毒の菌が広がる。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_arcane_po.source: This ring of arcane power will cause your staffs to recharge at an accelerated rate. Cursed rings of wisdom will cause your staffs to recharge more slowly.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_arcane_po.pattern: This ring of arcane power will cause your staffs to recharge at an accelerated rate. Cursed rings of wisdom will cause your staffs to recharge more slowly.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_arcane_po.text: 秘術の指輪。杖の再充填を速める。呪われた知恵の指輪は杖の再充填を遅くする。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_blood_mag.source: This ring of blood magic will heal you in proportion to the damage you inflict on others. Cursed rings will cause you to lose health when inflicting damage.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_blood_mag.pattern: This ring of blood magic will heal you in proportion to the damage you inflict on others. Cursed rings will cause you to lose health when inflicting damage.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_blood_mag.text: 血の魔法の指輪。他者に与えたダメージに応じて体力を回復する。呪われていると、ダメージを与える際に体力を失う。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_blood_mag.source: This ring of blood magic will recharge your staffs and charms every time you hit an enemy. Cursed rings of reaping will drain your staffs and charms with every hit.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_blood_mag.pattern: This ring of blood magic will recharge your staffs and charms every time you hit an enemy. Cursed rings of reaping will drain your staffs and charms with every hit.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_blood_mag.text: 血の魔法の指輪。敵への攻撃が命中するたびに杖とお守りを再充填する。呪われた収穫の指輪は命中のたびに充填を奪う。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_effortles.source: This ring of effortless vigilance will enable you to notice traps, secret doors and hidden levers more often and from a greater distance. Cursed rings of awareness will dull your senses, making it harder to notice secrets without actively searching for them.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_effortles.pattern: This ring of effortless vigilance will enable you to notice traps, secret doors and hidden levers more often and from a greater distance. Cursed rings of awareness will dull your senses, making it harder to notice secrets without actively searching for them.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_effortles.text: 努力せず警戒できる指輪。罠、隠し扉、隠れたレバーをより頻繁に、遠くから発見できる。呪われた警戒の指輪は感覚を鈍らせ、意識的に探さなければ秘密を見つけにくくする。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_eldritch_.source: This ring of eldritch scrying will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors, within a radius determined by the level of the ring. A cursed ring of clairvoyance will blind you to your immediate surroundings.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_eldritch_.pattern: This ring of eldritch scrying will permit you to see through nearby walls and doors, within a radius determined by the level of the ring. A cursed ring of clairvoyance will blind you to your immediate surroundings.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_eldritch_.text: 秘術で見通す指輪。指輪の強化値に応じた範囲で、近くの壁や扉の向こうを見られる。呪われた透視の指輪は周辺を見えなくする。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_preternat.source: This ring of preternatural vision will allow you to see farther in the dimming light of the deeper dungeon levels. It will not make you more noticeable to enemies.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_preternat.pattern: This ring of preternatural vision will allow you to see farther in the dimming light of the deeper dungeon levels. It will not make you more noticeable to enemies.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_preternat.text: 超自然的な視覚を与える指輪。深い迷宮の薄暗さでも遠くが見える。敵に見つかりやすくなることはない。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_sacred_li.source: This ring of sacred life will allow you to recover lost health at an accelerated rate. Cursed rings will decrease or even halt your natural regeneration.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_sacred_li.pattern: This ring of sacred life will allow you to recover lost health at an accelerated rate. Cursed rings will decrease or even halt your natural regeneration.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_sacred_li.text: 聖なる生命の指輪。失った体力の自然回復を速める。呪われていると自然回復を遅くし、止めることさえある。

globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_silent_pa.source: This ring of silent passage will reduce your stealth range, making enemies less likely to notice you and more likely to lose your trail. Staying motionless and lurking in the shadows will make you even harder to spot. Cursed rings of stealth will increase your stealth range, making you easier to spot and to track.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_silent_pa.pattern: This ring of silent passage will reduce your stealth range, making enemies less likely to notice you and more likely to lose your trail. Staying motionless and lurking in the shadows will make you even harder to spot. Cursed rings of stealth will increase your stealth range, making you easier to spot and to track.
globals.ringtable.this_ring_of_silent_pa.text: 静かに通行できる指輪。隠密範囲を狭め、敵に発見されにくく、追跡を振り切りやすくする。動かず影に潜むと、さらに見つかりにくい。呪われた隠密の指輪は隠密範囲を広げ、発見・追跡されやすくする。

globals.stafftable.a_flick_of_this_staff.source: A flick of this staff will summon a number of phantom blades to fight on your behalf.
globals.stafftable.a_flick_of_this_staff.pattern: A flick of this staff will summon a number of phantom blades to fight on your behalf.
globals.stafftable.a_flick_of_this_staff.text: 一振りすると、多数の幻影の刃を召喚して代わりに戦わせる杖。

globals.stafftable.bursts_of_magic_from_.source: Bursts of magic from this staff will pass harmlessly through creatures but will reduce most obstructions to rubble.
globals.stafftable.bursts_of_magic_from_.pattern: Bursts of magic from this staff will pass harmlessly through creatures but will reduce most obstructions to rubble.
globals.stafftable.bursts_of_magic_from_.text: 放った魔法は生物には害なく通り抜け、ほとんどの障害物を瓦礫に変える杖。

globals.stafftable.the_vile_blast_of_thi.source: The vile blast of this twisted staff will imbue its target with a deadly venom. Each turn, a creature that is poisoned will suffer one point of damage per dose of poison it has received, and poisoned creatures will not regenerate lost health until the poison clears.
globals.stafftable.the_vile_blast_of_thi.pattern: The vile blast of this twisted staff will imbue its target with a deadly venom. Each turn, a creature that is poisoned will suffer one point of damage per dose of poison it has received, and poisoned creatures will not regenerate lost health until the poison clears.
globals.stafftable.the_vile_blast_of_thi.text: このねじれた杖は、標的に致命的な毒を与える。毒を受けた生物は毎ターン、毒の量に応じて一点ずつダメージを受け、毒が抜けるまで自然回復しない。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_conjures_f.source: This staff conjures forth deadly arcs of electricity to damage to any number of creatures in a straight line.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_conjures_f.pattern: This staff conjures forth deadly arcs of electricity to damage to any number of creatures in a straight line.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_conjures_f.text: 致命的な電弧を放ち、一直線上のすべての生物にダメージを与える杖。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_unleashes_.source: This staff unleashes bursts of magical fire. It will ignite flammable terrain and burn any creature that it hits. Creatures with an immunity to fire will be unaffected by the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_unleashes_.pattern: This staff unleashes bursts of magical fire. It will ignite flammable terrain and burn any creature that it hits. Creatures with an immunity to fire will be unaffected by the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_unleashes_.text: 魔法の炎を放つ杖。燃える地形を点火し、命中した生物を焼く。耐火能力がある生物には効果がない。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_allow.source: This staff will allow you to teleport in the chosen direction. Creatures and inanimate obstructions will block the teleportation.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_allow.pattern: This staff will allow you to teleport in the chosen direction. Creatures and inanimate obstructions will block the teleportation.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_allow.text: 指定方向へ瞬間移動できる杖。生物や障害物に阻まれると、そこで移動が止まる。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_alter.source: This staff will alter the perception of a creature and cause it to lash out indiscriminately. Strangers and allies alike will turn on the victim.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_alter.pattern: This staff will alter the perception of a creature and cause it to lash out indiscriminately. Strangers and allies alike will turn on the victim.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_alter.text: 生物の認識を変え、無差別に攻撃させる杖。敵味方がともに標的へ敵対する。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_bathe.source: This staff will bathe a creature in a protective light that will absorb all damage until it is depleted. Unfortunately, you cannot use this or any staff on yourself except by reflecting the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_bathe.pattern: This staff will bathe a creature in a protective light that will absorb all damage until it is depleted. Unfortunately, you cannot use this or any staff on yourself except by reflecting the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_bathe.text: 生物を保護光で包み、光が尽きるまで全ダメージを吸収する杖。他の杖と同様、魔弾を反射させない限り自分自身には使えない。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_conju.source: This staff will conjure a mass of impenetrable green crystal, preventing anything from moving through the affected area and temporarily entombing anything that is already there. The crystal will dissolve into the air as time passes. Higher level staffs will create larger obstructions.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_conju.pattern: This staff will conjure a mass of impenetrable green crystal, preventing anything from moving through the affected area and temporarily entombing anything that is already there. The crystal will dissolve into the air as time passes. Higher level staffs will create larger obstructions.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_conju.text: 通れない緑の水晶を作る杖。範囲内の移動を阻み、すでにいる者を一時的に閉じ込める。水晶は時間とともに消え、強化値が高いほど障壁は大きくなる。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_heal_.source: This staff will heal any creature, friend or foe. Unfortunately, you cannot use this or any staff on yourself except by reflecting the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_heal_.pattern: This staff will heal any creature, friend or foe. Unfortunately, you cannot use this or any staff on yourself except by reflecting the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_heal_.text: 敵味方を問わず生物を治す杖。他の杖と同様、魔弾を反射させない限り自分自身には使えない。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_send_.source: This staff will send creatures into a temporary trance, causing them to mindlessly mirror your movements. You can use the effect to cause one creature to attack another or to step into hazardous terrain, but the spell will be broken if you attack the creature under the effect.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_send_.pattern: This staff will send creatures into a temporary trance, causing them to mindlessly mirror your movements. You can use the effect to cause one creature to attack another or to step into hazardous terrain, but the spell will be broken if you attack the creature under the effect.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_send_.text: 生物を一時的な恍惚状態にし、無意識にあなたの動きをまねさせる杖。他の生物を攻撃させたり危険な地形に踏み込ませたりできるが、本人を攻撃すると効果が解ける。

globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_tempo.source: This staff will temporarily double the speed of any creature, friend or foe. Unfortunately, you cannot use this or any staff on yourself except by reflecting the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_tempo.pattern: This staff will temporarily double the speed of any creature, friend or foe. Unfortunately, you cannot use this or any staff on yourself except by reflecting the bolt.
globals.stafftable.this_staff_will_tempo.text: 敵味方を問わず、生物の速さを一時的に二倍にする杖。他の杖と同様、魔弾を反射させない限り自分自身には使えない。

globals.tilecatalog.this_area_happens_to.text: この場所は影に覆われている。隠れるのに安全かもしれない。

globals.tilecatalog.this_pressure_plate_.source: This pressure plate has already been depressed.
globals.tilecatalog.this_pressure_plate_.pattern: This pressure plate has already been depressed.
globals.tilecatalog.this_pressure_plate_.text: この圧力板はすでに押されている。

globals.tilecatalog.this_spindly_plant_g.source: this spindly plant grows seed pods famous for their healing properties.
globals.tilecatalog.this_spindly_plant_g.pattern: this spindly plant grows seed pods famous for their healing properties.
globals.tilecatalog.this_spindly_plant_g.text: このひょろ長い植物は、治癒作用で知られる種の莢を実らせる。

globals.tilecatalog.thorned_vines_make_a.source: thorned vines make a rustling noise as they quiver restlessly.
globals.tilecatalog.thorned_vines_make_a.pattern: thorned vines make a rustling noise as they quiver restlessly.
globals.tilecatalog.thorned_vines_make_a.text: 棘のある蔓が落ち着きなく震え、ざわめく。

globals.tilecatalog.tufts_of_lush_grass_.source: tufts of lush grass have improbably pushed upward through the stone ground.
globals.tilecatalog.tufts_of_lush_grass_.pattern: tufts of lush grass have improbably pushed upward through the stone ground.
globals.tilecatalog.tufts_of_lush_grass_.text: 豊かな草の房が、ありえないことに石の地面を押し上げている。

globals.tilecatalog.unidentifiable_bones.source: unidentifiable bones, yellowed with age, litter the ground.
globals.tilecatalog.unidentifiable_bones.pattern: unidentifiable bones, yellowed with age, litter the ground.
globals.tilecatalog.unidentifiable_bones.text: 年月で黄ばんだ正体不明の骨が、地面に散らばる。

globals.tilecatalog.venomous_barbs_cover.source: venomous barbs cover the quivering tendrils of this fast-growing lichen.
globals.tilecatalog.venomous_barbs_cover.pattern: venomous barbs cover the quivering tendrils of this fast-growing lichen.
globals.tilecatalog.venomous_barbs_cover.text: 急成長する地衣の震える蔓に、毒の棘が生えている。

globals.tilecatalog.worm_viscera_cover_t.text: ワームの内臓が地面を覆う。

globals.tilecatalog.you_are_knee_deep_in.source: you are knee-deep in thick, foul-smelling mud.
globals.tilecatalog.you_are_knee_deep_in.pattern: you are knee-deep in thick, foul-smelling mud.
globals.tilecatalog.you_are_knee_deep_in.text: 膝まで濃く悪臭のする泥に浸かっている。

globals.tilecatalog.you_can_feel_the_pur.source: you can feel the purple gas eating at your flesh.
globals.tilecatalog.you_can_feel_the_pur.pattern: you can feel the purple gas eating at your flesh.
globals.tilecatalog.you_can_feel_the_pur.text: 紫のガスが肉をむしばむのを感じる。

globals.tilecatalog.you_feel_the_crystal.source: You feel the crystal's glossy surface and admire the dancing lights beneath.
globals.tilecatalog.you_feel_the_crystal.pattern: You feel the crystal's glossy surface and admire the dancing lights beneath.
globals.tilecatalog.you_feel_the_crystal.text: 水晶の滑らかな表面に触れ、内側で踊る光に見入る。

globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_downward_.source: you plunge downward into the chasm!
globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_downward_.pattern: you plunge downward into the chasm!

globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_downward_.source: you plunge downward into the hole!
globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_downward_.pattern: you plunge downward into the hole!

globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_through_a.source: you plunge through a hidden trap door!
globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_through_a.pattern: you plunge through a hidden trap door!
globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_through_a.text: 隠された落とし戸から落下する！

globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_through_a.source: you plunge through a hole in the ground!
globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_through_a.pattern: you plunge through a hole in the ground!
globals.tilecatalog.you_plunge_through_a.text: 地面の穴から落下する！

globals.tilecatalog.you_push_through_the.source: you push through the animal skins that hang across the threshold.
globals.tilecatalog.you_push_through_the.pattern: you push through the animal skins that hang across the threshold.
globals.tilecatalog.you_push_through_the.text: 入口に垂れた獣皮を押しのけて通る。

globals.tilecatalog.you_retch_violently_.source: you retch violently at the smell of the greasy smoke.
globals.tilecatalog.you_retch_violently_.pattern: you retch violently at the smell of the greasy smoke.
globals.tilecatalog.you_retch_violently_.text: 脂ぎった煙の臭いで激しくえずく。

globals.tilecatalog.you_search_your_pack.source: you search your pack but do not have a matching key.
globals.tilecatalog.you_search_your_pack.pattern: you search your pack but do not have a matching key.
globals.tilecatalog.you_search_your_pack.text: 持ち物を探したが、合う鍵がない。

globals.tilecatalog.you_see_netting_subt.source: you see netting subtly concealed in the ceiling over a hidden pressure plate.
globals.tilecatalog.you_see_netting_subt.pattern: you see netting subtly concealed in the ceiling over a hidden pressure plate.
globals.tilecatalog.you_see_netting_subt.text: 隠れた圧力板の上の天井に、巧妙に隠された網が見える。

globals.weapontable.a_long_steel_pole_en.source: A long steel pole ending in a razor-sharp point. The reach of the pike permits you to simultaneously attack an adjacent enemy and the enemy directly behind it.
globals.weapontable.a_long_steel_pole_en.pattern: A long steel pole ending in a razor-sharp point. The reach of the pike permits you to simultaneously attack an adjacent enemy and the enemy directly behind it.
globals.weapontable.a_long_steel_pole_en.text: 鋭い穂先を備えた長い鋼の棒。長槍の間合いを生かして、隣接する敵と、その真後ろの敵を同時に攻撃できる。

globals.weapontable.a_simple_iron_dagger.source: A simple iron dagger with a well-worn wooden handle. Daggers will deal quintuple damage upon a successful sneak attack instead of triple damage.
globals.weapontable.a_simple_iron_dagger.pattern: A simple iron dagger with a well-worn wooden handle. Daggers will deal quintuple damage upon a successful sneak attack instead of triple damage.
globals.weapontable.a_simple_iron_dagger.text: 使い込まれた木の柄の、簡素な鉄の短剣。不意打ちが成功すると、通常の三倍ではなく五倍のダメージを与える。

globals.weapontable.a_slender_wooden_rod.source: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron. The reach of the spear permits you to simultaneously attack an adjacent enemy and the enemy directly behind it.
globals.weapontable.a_slender_wooden_rod.pattern: A slender wooden rod tipped with sharpened iron. The reach of the spear permits you to simultaneously attack an adjacent enemy and the enemy directly behind it.
globals.weapontable.a_slender_wooden_rod.text: 鋭い鉄の穂先を備えた細い木の棒。槍の間合いを生かして、隣接する敵と、その真後ろの敵を同時に攻撃できる。

globals.weapontable.few_creatures_can_wi.source: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but only the strongest of adventurers can effectively wield it. Because of its heft, it takes an extra turn to recover when it hits, and will push your opponent backward if there is room.
globals.weapontable.few_creatures_can_wi.pattern: Few creatures can withstand the crushing blow of this towering mass of lead and steel, but only the strongest of adventurers can effectively wield it. Because of its heft, it takes an extra turn to recover when it hits, and will push your opponent backward if there is room.
globals.weapontable.few_creatures_can_wi.text: 巨大な鉛と鋼の塊の一撃に耐える生物は少ないが、最も強い冒険者しか扱えない。重いため命中後に立て直すのに一ターン余分にかかり、空間があれば敵を後ろへ押す。

globals.weapontable.the_barbed_spike_on_.source: The barbed spike on each of these darts is designed to stick to its target while the compounds strapped to its length explode into flame.
globals.weapontable.the_barbed_spike_on_.pattern: The barbed spike on each of these darts is designed to stick to its target while the compounds strapped to its length explode into flame.
globals.weapontable.the_barbed_spike_on_.text: この投げ矢の返し付きの針は標的に刺さるよう作られ、取り付けられた化合物が炎を上げて爆発する。

globals.weapontable.the_blunt_iron_edge_.source: The blunt iron edge on this axe glints in the darkness. The arc of its swing permits you to attack all adjacent enemies simultaneously.
globals.weapontable.the_blunt_iron_edge_.pattern: The blunt iron edge on this axe glints in the darkness. The arc of its swing permits you to attack all adjacent enemies simultaneously.
globals.weapontable.the_blunt_iron_edge_.text: 斧の鈍い鉄の刃が闇で輝く。弧を描いて振ることで、隣接するすべての敵を同時に攻撃できる。

globals.weapontable.the_enormous_steel_h.source: The enormous steel head of this war axe puts considerable heft behind each stroke. The arc of its swing permits you to attack all adjacent enemies simultaneously.
globals.weapontable.the_enormous_steel_h.pattern: The enormous steel head of this war axe puts considerable heft behind each stroke. The arc of its swing permits you to attack all adjacent enemies simultaneously.
globals.weapontable.the_enormous_steel_h.text: 戦斧の巨大な鋼の頭部は一振りにかなりの重みを加える。弧を描いて振ることで、隣接するすべての敵を同時に攻撃できる。

globals.weapontable.the_iron_flanges_at_.source: The iron flanges at the head of this weapon inflict substantial damage with every weighty blow. Because of its heft, it takes an extra turn to recover when it hits, and will push your opponent backward if there is room.
globals.weapontable.the_iron_flanges_at_.pattern: The iron flanges at the head of this weapon inflict substantial damage with every weighty blow. Because of its heft, it takes an extra turn to recover when it hits, and will push your opponent backward if there is room.
globals.weapontable.the_iron_flanges_at_.text: 頭部の鉄の突起が、重い一撃ごとに大きなダメージを与える。重いため命中後に立て直すのに一ターン余分にかかり、空間があれば敵を後ろへ押す。

globals.weapontable.the_lash_from_this_c.source: The lash from this coil of braided leather can tear bark from trees, and it will reach opponents up to five spaces away.
globals.weapontable.the_lash_from_this_c.pattern: The lash from this coil of braided leather can tear bark from trees, and it will reach opponents up to five spaces away.
globals.weapontable.the_lash_from_this_c.text: 編んだ革の鞭は木の皮を剥がせるほど強く、五マス先の敵まで届く。

globals.weapontable.the_razor_sharp_leng.source: The razor-sharp length of steel blade shines reassuringly.
globals.weapontable.the_razor_sharp_leng.pattern: The razor-sharp length of steel blade shines reassuringly.
globals.weapontable.the_razor_sharp_leng.text: 鋭い鋼の長い刃が、頼もしく輝いている。

globals.weapontable.these_simple_metal_s.source: These simple metal spikes are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist.
globals.weapontable.these_simple_metal_s.pattern: These simple metal spikes are weighted to fly true and sting their prey with a flick of the wrist.
globals.weapontable.these_simple_metal_s.text: 単純な金属の針。手首の一振りでまっすぐ飛び、獲物を刺すよう重さが調整されている。

globals.weapontable.this_blade_is_thin_a.source: This blade is thin and flexible, designed for deft and rapid maneuvers. It inflicts less damage than comparable weapons, but permits you to attack twice as quickly. If there is one space between you and an enemy and you step directly toward it, you will perform a devastating lunge attack, which deals triple damage and never misses.
globals.weapontable.this_blade_is_thin_a.pattern: This blade is thin and flexible, designed for deft and rapid maneuvers. It inflicts less damage than comparable weapons, but permits you to attack twice as quickly. If there is one space between you and an enemy and you step directly toward it, you will perform a devastating lunge attack, which deals triple damage and never misses.
globals.weapontable.this_blade_is_thin_a.text: 薄く柔軟な刃は素早い動き向け。同程度の武器よりダメージは少ないが、二倍の速さで攻撃できる。敵との間が一マス空いているときに真っすぐ近づくと、三倍のダメージで必中の突進攻撃を行う。

globals.weapontable.this_length_of_metal.source: This length of metal is weighted to keep the spike at its tip foremost as it sails through the air.
globals.weapontable.this_length_of_metal.pattern: This length of metal is weighted to keep the spike at its tip foremost as it sails through the air.
globals.weapontable.this_length_of_metal.text: 空中を飛ぶ際に穂先が前を向くよう、重さを調整した金属の棒。

globals.weapontable.this_spiked_iron_bal.source: This spiked iron ball can be whirled at the end of its chain in synchronicity with your movement, allowing you a free attack whenever moving between two spaces that are adjacent to an enemy.
globals.weapontable.this_spiked_iron_bal.pattern: This spiked iron ball can be whirled at the end of its chain in synchronicity with your movement, allowing you a free attack whenever moving between two spaces that are adjacent to an enemy.
globals.weapontable.this_spiked_iron_bal.text: 鎖の先の棘付き鉄球を移動と合わせて回せる。敵に隣接する二マス間を移動すると、無料の攻撃を行う。

globals.weapontable.this_towering_blade_.source: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every cut.
globals.weapontable.this_towering_blade_.pattern: This towering blade inflicts heavy damage by investing its heft into every cut.
globals.weapontable.this_towering_blade_.text: 巨大な刃は一振りごとに重さを生かし、大きなダメージを与える。

globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.breathe.pattern: breathes a gout of white-hot flame

globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.can_dup.text: 他の生物を複製できる

globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.can_lau.text: 粘つく蜘蛛の糸を飛ばせる

globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.can_pol.text: 他の生物を変身させられる

globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.can_tel.text: 他の生物を転送できる
