globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.release.pattern: releases carnivorous vines into the ground
globalsbrogue.boltcatalog_brogue.release.text: 肉食の蔓を地面に放つ

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_featur.source: A featureless gray disc hangs from a lanyard. When you touch it, your hand and arm go numb.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_featur.pattern: A featureless gray disc hangs from a lanyard. When you touch it, your hand and arm go numb.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_featur.text: 特徴のない灰色の円盤が紐に吊られている。触れると手と腕の感覚がなくなる。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_handfu.source: A handful of dried bloodwort and mandrake root has been bound together with leather cord and imbued with a powerful healing magic.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_handfu.pattern: A handful of dried bloodwort and mandrake root has been bound together with leather cord and imbued with a powerful healing magic.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_handfu.text: 乾燥したブラッドワートとマンドラゴラの根を革紐で束ね、強力な治癒の魔法を込めたもの。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_jade_f.source: A jade figurine depicts a strange humanoid creature. It has a face on both sides of its head, but all four eyes are closed.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_jade_f.pattern: A jade figurine depicts a strange humanoid creature. It has a face on both sides of its head, but all four eyes are closed.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_jade_f.text: 奇妙な人型の生物をかたどった翡翠の像。頭の両側に顔があるが、四つの目はすべて閉じている。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_strip_.source: A strip of bronze has been wound around a rough wooden sphere. Each time you touch it, you feel a tiny electric shock.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_strip_.pattern: A strip of bronze has been wound around a rough wooden sphere. Each time you touch it, you feel a tiny electric shock.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.a_strip_.text: 粗い木の球に青銅の帯を巻いたもの。触れるたびに小さな電気の衝撃を感じる。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.eldritch.source: Eldritch flames flicker within this polished crystal bauble.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.eldritch.pattern: Eldritch flames flicker within this polished crystal bauble.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.eldritch.text: 磨かれた水晶の小物の中で、妖しい炎が揺れる。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.four_cop.source: Four copper rings have been joined into a tetrahedron. The construct is oddly warm to the touch.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.four_cop.pattern: Four copper rings have been joined into a tetrahedron. The construct is oddly warm to the touch.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.four_cop.text: 四つの銅の輪をつなぎ合わせた四面体。触れると不思議に温かい。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.seven_ti.source: Seven tiny glass eyes roll freely within this glass sphere. Somehow, they always come to rest facing outward.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.seven_ti.pattern: Seven tiny glass eyes roll freely within this glass sphere. Somehow, they always come to rest facing outward.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.seven_ti.text: このガラス球の中で七つの小さなガラスの目が転がる。なぜか止まると常に外を向く。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.sparklin.source: Sparkling dust and fragments of feather waft and swirl endlessly inside this small glass sphere.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.sparklin.pattern: Sparkling dust and fragments of feather waft and swirl endlessly inside this small glass sphere.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.sparklin.text: 小さなガラス球の中で、きらめく粉と羽の破片が絶えず漂い、渦を巻く。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.the_surf.source: The surface of this nickel sphere has been etched with a perfect grid pattern. Somehow, the squares of the grid are all exactly the same size.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.the_surf.pattern: The surface of this nickel sphere has been etched with a perfect grid pattern. Somehow, the squares of the grid are all exactly the same size.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.the_surf.text: ニッケルの球の表面に完全な格子が刻まれている。なぜか格子の升目はすべて同じ大きさだ。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.this_tur.source: This turquoise crystal, fixed to a leather lanyard, hums with an arcane energy that sets your teeth on edge.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.this_tur.pattern: This turquoise crystal, fixed to a leather lanyard, hums with an arcane energy that sets your teeth on edge.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.this_tur.text: 革紐に付けられた青緑の水晶が、歯を不快に響かせる秘術の力でうなる。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.various_.source: Various animals have been etched into the surface of this brass bangle. It emits a barely audible hum.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.various_.pattern: Various animals have been etched into the surface of this brass bangle. It emits a barely audible hum.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.various_.text: 真鍮の腕輪の表面に様々な動物が刻まれている。ほとんど聞こえない音でうなる。

globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.when_you.source: When you touch this tiny granite statue, a rhythmic booming echoes in your mind.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.when_you.pattern: When you touch this tiny granite statue, a rhythmic booming echoes in your mind.
globalsbrogue.charmtable_brogue.when_you.text: 小さな花崗岩の像に触れると、規則的な轟音が頭の中に響く。

globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.ascend_wi.source: Ascend without attacking an unaware or fleeing creature.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.ascend_wi.pattern: Ascend without attacking an unaware or fleeing creature.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.ascend_wi.text: 気付いていない、または逃げている生物を攻撃せずに脱出する。
金貨を拾わずに脱出する。

globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.ascend_wi.source: Ascend without using a staff, wand or charm.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.ascend_wi.pattern: Ascend without using a staff, wand or charm.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.ascend_wi.text: 杖、魔法棒、お守りを使わずに脱出する。
武器を使わずに脱出する。

globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.enchant_a.text: アイテムを+16まで強化する。

globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.explore_1.source: Explore 13 new depths with an ally.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.explore_1.pattern: Explore 13 new depths with an ally.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.explore_1.text: 味方とともに新たな十三階分を探索する。

globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.obtain_90.text: 九十体のゼリーを同時に味方にする。

globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.slay_a_dr.source: Slay a dragon with a melee attack.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.slay_a_dr.pattern: Slay a dragon with a melee attack.
globalsbrogue.feattable_brogue.slay_a_dr.text: 近接攻撃でドラゴンを倒す。

globalsbrogue.levelfeelings_brogue.an_al.source: An alien energy permeates the area. The Amulet of Yendor must be nearby!
globalsbrogue.levelfeelings_brogue.an_al.pattern: An alien energy permeates the area. The Amulet of Yendor must be nearby!
globalsbrogue.levelfeelings_brogue.an_al.text: 異質な力が周囲を満たす。イェンダーの魔除けは近い！

globalsbrogue.levelfeelings_brogue.an_ov.source: An overwhelming sense of peace and tranquility settles upon you.
globalsbrogue.levelfeelings_brogue.an_ov.pattern: An overwhelming sense of peace and tranquility settles upon you.
globalsbrogue.levelfeelings_brogue.an_ov.text: 圧倒的な平和と静けさに包まれる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.a_swirl.source: A swirling elixir that will instantly heal you, cure you of ailments, and permanently increase your maximum health.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.a_swirl.pattern: A swirling elixir that will instantly heal you, cure you of ailments, and permanently increase your maximum health.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.a_swirl.text: 渦巻く霊薬。瞬時に治癒し、異常を治し、最大体力を永続的に増やす。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.drinkin.source: Drinking this potion will plunge you into darkness. At first, you will be completely blind to anything not illuminated by an independent light source, but over time your vision will regain its former strength. Throwing the potion will create a cloud of supernatural darkness, and enemies will have difficulty seeing or following you if you take refuge under its cover.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.drinkin.pattern: Drinking this potion will plunge you into darkness. At first, you will be completely blind to anything not illuminated by an independent light source, but over time your vision will regain its former strength. Throwing the potion will create a cloud of supernatural darkness, and enemies will have difficulty seeing or following you if you take refuge under its cover.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.drinkin.text: 飲むと闇に包まれる。最初は独立した光源で照らされたもの以外見えなくなるが、時間とともに視力が戻る。投げると超自然的な闇の雲を作り、その中に隠れると敵に発見・追跡されにくくなる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.drinkin.source: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. Enemies more than two spaces away will be unable to track you.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.drinkin.pattern: Drinking this potion will render you temporarily invisible. Enemies more than two spaces away will be unable to track you.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.drinkin.text: 飲むと一時的に透明になる。二マスより遠い敵は追跡できなくなる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.quaffin.source: Quaffing the contents of this flask will enable you to move at blinding speed for several minutes.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.quaffin.pattern: Quaffing the contents of this flask will enable you to move at blinding speed for several minutes.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.quaffin.text: この瓶の中身を飲むと、数分の間、目にも止まらぬ速さで動ける。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_cu.source: This curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over lava, water, chasms and traps. Flames, gases and spiderwebs fill the air, and cannot be bypassed while airborne. Creatures that dwell in water or mud will be unable to attack you while you levitate.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_cu.pattern: This curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over lava, water, chasms and traps. Flames, gases and spiderwebs fill the air, and cannot be bypassed while airborne. Creatures that dwell in water or mud will be unable to attack you while you levitate.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_cu.text: 不思議な液体は空中に浮かせ、溶岩、水、深淵、罠を簡単に越えさせる。炎、ガス、蜘蛛の巣は空中にもあるため避けられない。浮遊中は水や泥の生物から攻撃されない。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_fl.source: This flask contains a vicious and long-lasting hallucinogen. Under its dazzling effect, you will wander through a rainbow wonderland, unable to discern the form of any creatures or items you see.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_fl.pattern: This flask contains a vicious and long-lasting hallucinogen. Under its dazzling effect, you will wander through a rainbow wonderland, unable to discern the form of any creatures or items you see.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_fl.text: 強力で長時間続く幻覚剤。虹色の世界をさまよい、見える生物やアイテムの正体を判別できなくなる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_fl.source: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air. You might throw the flask at distant enemies -- or into a deep lake, to cleanse the cavern with scalding steam.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_fl.pattern: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air. You might throw the flask at distant enemies -- or into a deep lake, to cleanse the cavern with scalding steam.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_fl.text: 外気に触れると激しく燃える不安定な化合物。遠くの敵に投げたり、深い湖に投げて洞窟を熱い蒸気で満たしたりできる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_my.source: This mysterious brew will sensitize your mind to the radiance of magic. Items imbued with helpful enchantments will be marked with a full sigil; items corrupted by curses or designed to bring misfortune upon the bearer will be marked with a hollow sigil. The Amulet of Yendor will be revealed by its unique aura.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_my.pattern: This mysterious brew will sensitize your mind to the radiance of magic. Items imbued with helpful enchantments will be marked with a full sigil; items corrupted by curses or designed to bring misfortune upon the bearer will be marked with a hollow sigil. The Amulet of Yendor will be revealed by its unique aura.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_my.text: この薬は魔力の輝きを心で感じさせる。有益な魔法のアイテムは塗り潰した印、呪いや持ち主に害をもたらすアイテムは中空の印で示される。イェンダーの魔除けは固有の気配でわかる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_my.source: This mysterious liquid will attune your mind to the psychic signature of distant creatures. Its effects will not reveal inanimate objects, such as totems, turrets and traps.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_my.pattern: This mysterious liquid will attune your mind to the psychic signature of distant creatures. Its effects will not reveal inanimate objects, such as totems, turrets and traps.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_my.text: 遠くの生物の精神の気配を感じさせる液体。トーテム、砲台、罠などの無生物はわからない。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_po.source: This potion will render you impervious to heat and permit you to wander through fire and lava and ignore otherwise deadly bolts of flame. It will not guard against the concussive impact of an explosion, however.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_po.pattern: This potion will render you impervious to heat and permit you to wander through fire and lava and ignore otherwise deadly bolts of flame. It will not guard against the concussive impact of an explosion, however.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_po.text: 熱を防ぎ、火や溶岩を歩けるようにし、致命的な火炎弾も無効にする。ただし爆発の衝撃は防げない。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_po.source: This powerful medicine will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_po.pattern: This powerful medicine will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_po.text: この強力な薬は筋肉に行き渡り、筋力を永続的に一点増やす。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_un.source: This unstable chemical will quickly vaporize into a glittering cloud upon contact with open air, causing any creature that inhales it to lose control of the direction of its movements until the effect wears off (although its ability to aim projectile attacks will not be affected). Its vertiginous intoxication can cause creatures and adventurers to careen into one another or into chasms or lava pits, so extreme care should be taken when under its effect. Its contents can be weaponized by throwing the flask at distant enemies.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_un.pattern: This unstable chemical will quickly vaporize into a glittering cloud upon contact with open air, causing any creature that inhales it to lose control of the direction of its movements until the effect wears off (although its ability to aim projectile attacks will not be affected). Its vertiginous intoxication can cause creatures and adventurers to careen into one another or into chasms or lava pits, so extreme care should be taken when under its effect. Its contents can be weaponized by throwing the flask at distant enemies.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.this_un.text: 外気に触れるときらめく雲になる不安定な薬品。吸った生物は効果が切れるまで移動の方向を制御できないが、遠距離攻撃の狙いは保てる。生物や冒険者が衝突したり、深淵や溶岩へ踏み込んだりするので細心の注意が必要。遠くの敵に投げて武器にもできる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.uncorki.source: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of caustic purple gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.uncorki.pattern: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of caustic purple gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.uncorki.text: 栓を抜くか瓶を割ると、圧縮された中身が致命的な紫の腐食ガスとして広がる。手で開けず、遠くの敵に投げることもできる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.upon_ex.source: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing pink haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.upon_ex.pattern: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing pink haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.upon_ex.text: 外気に触れると、感覚を奪う桃色の霧になる。吸った者は即座に麻痺し、雲が消えてからもしばらく動けない。遠くの敵へ投げ、ガスに巻き込める。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.when_th.source: When the cork is popped or the flask is thrown, tiny spores will spill across the ground and begin to grow a deadly lichen. Anything that touches the lichen will be poisoned by its clinging tendrils, and the lichen will slowly grow to fill the area. Fire will purge the infestation.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.when_th.pattern: When the cork is popped or the flask is thrown, tiny spores will spill across the ground and begin to grow a deadly lichen. Anything that touches the lichen will be poisoned by its clinging tendrils, and the lichen will slowly grow to fill the area. Fire will purge the infestation.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.when_th.text: 栓を抜くか投げて割ると、小さな胞子が地面に広がり、致命的な地衣が生える。接触したものは蔓で毒を受け、地衣はゆっくり周囲へ広がる。火で除去できる。

globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.when_th.source: When this flask is uncorked by hand or shattered by being thrown, the fog that seeps out will temporarily cause the ground in the vicinity to vanish.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.when_th.pattern: When this flask is uncorked by hand or shattered by being thrown, the fog that seeps out will temporarily cause the ground in the vicinity to vanish.
globalsbrogue.potiontable_brogue.when_th.text: 手で栓を抜くか投げて割ると、漏れ出す霧が周囲の地面を一時的に消す。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.the_pow.source: The power bound up in this parchment will instantly recharge all of your staffs and charms.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.the_pow.pattern: The power bound up in this parchment will instantly recharge all of your staffs and charms.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.the_pow.text: この羊皮紙に宿る力は、すべての杖とお守りを瞬時に再充填する。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_an.source: This ancient enchanting sorcery will imbue a single item with a powerful and permanent magical charge. A staff will increase in power and in number of charges; a weapon will inflict more damage and find its mark more easily; a suit of armor will deflect attacks more often; the magic of a ring will intensify; and a wand will gain expendable charges in the least amount that such a wand can be found with. Weapons and armor will also require less strength to use, and any curses on the item will be lifted.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_an.pattern: This ancient enchanting sorcery will imbue a single item with a powerful and permanent magical charge. A staff will increase in power and in number of charges; a weapon will inflict more damage and find its mark more easily; a suit of armor will deflect attacks more often; the magic of a ring will intensify; and a wand will gain expendable charges in the least amount that such a wand can be found with. Weapons and armor will also require less strength to use, and any curses on the item will be lifted.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_an.text: 古い強化魔法は、一つのアイテムに強力で永続的な魔力を与える。杖は威力と充填上限が増し、武器はダメージと命中率が上がり、鎧は攻撃を弾きやすくなり、指輪の魔法は強くなる。魔法棒は発見時の最低量分の充填を得る。武器と鎧の必要筋力は減り、呪いも解ける。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_ce.source: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your weapon against degradation by acid.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_ce.pattern: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your weapon against degradation by acid.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_ce.text: この儀式の保護魔法は、武器を酸による劣化から永続的に守る。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_ce.source: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your armor against degradation by acid.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_ce.pattern: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your armor against degradation by acid.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_ce.text: この儀式の保護魔法は、鎧を酸による劣化から永続的に守る。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_es.source: This escape spell will instantly relocate you to a random location on the dungeon level. It can be used to escape a dangerous situation with luck. The unlucky reader might find himself in an even more dangerous place.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_es.pattern: This escape spell will instantly relocate you to a random location on the dungeon level. It can be used to escape a dangerous situation with luck. The unlucky reader might find himself in an even more dangerous place.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_es.text: 迷宮の同じ階の無作為な場所へ瞬時に移す脱出魔法。幸運なら危機から逃れられるが、不運ならさらに危険な場所へ行くこともある。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_po.source: This powerful scouting magic will etch a purple-hued image of crystal clarity into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all traps, secret doors and hidden levers.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_po.pattern: This powerful scouting magic will etch a purple-hued image of crystal clarity into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all traps, secret doors and hidden levers.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_po.text: この強力な偵察魔法は、鮮明な紫の地図を記憶に刻み、この階の正確な配置とすべての罠、隠し扉、隠れたレバーを示す。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_pr.source: This protection rite will imbue the area with powerful warding glyphs, when released over plain ground. Monsters will not willingly set foot on the affected area.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_pr.pattern: This protection rite will imbue the area with powerful warding glyphs, when released over plain ground. Monsters will not willingly set foot on the affected area.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_pr.text: 普通の地面で解き放つと、周囲に強力な守護の紋様を刻む保護儀式。怪物は自らその範囲に踏み込もうとしない。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_re.source: This redemption spell will instantly strip from the reader's weapon, armor, rings and carried items any evil enchantments that might prevent the wearer from removing them.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_re.pattern: This redemption spell will instantly strip from the reader's weapon, armor, rings and carried items any evil enchantments that might prevent the wearer from removing them.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_re.text: 装備を外せなくする邪悪な魔法を、武器、鎧、指輪、持ち物から瞬時に取り去る解呪魔法。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.source: This scroll will unleash a piercing shriek that will awaken all monsters and alert them to the reader's location.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.pattern: This scroll will unleash a piercing shriek that will awaken all monsters and alert them to the reader's location.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.text: 鋭い叫びを放ち、すべての怪物を起こして読んだ者の位置を知らせる巻物。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.source: This scroll will unleash a powerful blast of mind magic. Any creatures within line of sight will turn against their companions and attack indiscriminately for 30 turns.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.pattern: This scroll will unleash a powerful blast of mind magic. Any creatures within line of sight will turn against their companions and attack indiscriminately for 30 turns.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.text: 強力な精神魔法を放つ巻物。見える範囲の生物は仲間に敵対し、三十ターンの間、無差別に攻撃する。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.source: This scrying magic will permanently reveal all of the secrets of a single item.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.pattern: This scrying magic will permanently reveal all of the secrets of a single item.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_sc.text: 一つのアイテムの秘密を、永続的にすべて明らかにする透視の魔法。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_st.source: This strange incantation will alter the physical structure of nearby stone, causing it to evaporate into the air over the ensuing minutes.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_st.pattern: This strange incantation will alter the physical structure of nearby stone, causing it to evaporate into the air over the ensuing minutes.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_st.text: 近くの石の構造を変え、数分の間に空気へ蒸発させる奇妙な呪文。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_su.source: This summoning incantation will call out to creatures in other planes of existence, drawing them through the fabric of reality to confront the reader.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_su.pattern: This summoning incantation will call out to creatures in other planes of existence, drawing them through the fabric of reality to confront the reader.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.this_su.text: 異世界の生物を呼び、現実の境を越えて読んだ者に対峙させる召喚呪文。

globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.when_th.source: When this powerful anti-magic is released, all creatures (including yourself) and all items lying on the ground within your field of view will be exposed to its blast and stripped of magic. Creatures animated purely by magic will die. Potions, scrolls, items being held by other creatures and items in your inventory will not be affected.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.when_th.pattern: When this powerful anti-magic is released, all creatures (including yourself) and all items lying on the ground within your field of view will be exposed to its blast and stripped of magic. Creatures animated purely by magic will die. Potions, scrolls, items being held by other creatures and items in your inventory will not be affected.
globalsbrogue.scrolltable_brogue.when_th.text: 強力な反魔法。視野内のすべての生物（自分を含む）と地面のアイテムから魔力を奪う。魔法だけで動く生物は死ぬ。薬、巻物、生物が持つアイテム、持ち物は影響を受けない。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.the_creat.source: The creature at the other end of this mischievous bit of cloning magic, friend or foe, will be beside itself -- literally!
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.the_creat.pattern: The creature at the other end of this mischievous bit of cloning magic, friend or foe, will be beside itself -- literally!
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.the_creat.text: いたずらな複製魔法を受けた生物は、敵でも味方でも、文字どおり自分と隣り合わせになる！

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.the_force.source: The force of this wand will draw the targeted creature into direct proximity.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.the_force.pattern: The force of this wand will draw the targeted creature into direct proximity.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.the_force.text: 標的の生物をすぐ隣まで引き寄せる魔法棒。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_misc.source: This mischievous magic will transform a creature into another creature at random. Beware: the tamest of creatures might turn into the most fearsome. The horror of the transformation will turn an allied victim against you.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_misc.pattern: This mischievous magic will transform a creature into another creature at random. Beware: the tamest of creatures might turn into the most fearsome. The horror of the transformation will turn an allied victim against you.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_misc.text: 生物を無作為な別の生物に変える、いたずらな魔法。おとなしい生物が最も恐ろしいものになることもある。変身の恐怖により、味方だった標的は敵対する。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_powe.source: This powerful anti-magic will strip a creature of a host of magical traits, including flight, invisibility, acidic corrosiveness, telepathy, magical speed or slowness, hypnosis, magical fear, immunity to physical attack, fire resistance and the ability to blink. Spellcasters will lose their magical abilities and magical totems will be rendered inert. Creatures animated purely by magic will die.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_powe.pattern: This powerful anti-magic will strip a creature of a host of magical traits, including flight, invisibility, acidic corrosiveness, telepathy, magical speed or slowness, hypnosis, magical fear, immunity to physical attack, fire resistance and the ability to blink. Spellcasters will lose their magical abilities and magical totems will be rendered inert. Creatures animated purely by magic will die.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_powe.text: 飛行、透明化、酸の腐食性、精神感応、魔法の加速・減速、催眠、魔法の恐怖、物理攻撃への免疫、耐火、瞬間移動など、多くの特殊能力を取り去る強力な反魔法。術者は魔法能力を失い、トーテムは動かなくなる。魔法だけで動く生物は死ぬ。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_sacr.source: This sacred magic will permanently improve the mind and body of any monster it hits. A wise adventurer will use it on allies, making them stronger in combat and able to learn a new talent from a fallen foe. If the bolt is reflected back at you, it will have no effect.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_sacr.pattern: This sacred magic will permanently improve the mind and body of any monster it hits. A wise adventurer will use it on allies, making them stronger in combat and able to learn a new talent from a fallen foe. If the bolt is reflected back at you, it will have no effect.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_sacr.text: 命中した怪物の心身を永続的に強化する聖なる魔法。賢い冒険者は味方に使い、戦闘力を高め、倒した敵から新しい能力を一つ学べるようにする。自分へ反射されても効果はない。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.source: This wand can forever bind an enemy to the caster's will, turning it into a steadfast ally. However, the magic only works effectively against enemies that are near death.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.pattern: This wand can forever bind an enemy to the caster's will, turning it into a steadfast ally. However, the magic only works effectively against enemies that are near death.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.text: 敵を永続的に従え、忠実な味方にする魔法棒。ただし死にかけの敵にしか有効に働かない。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.source: This wand will cause a creature to move at half its ordinary speed for 30 turns.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.pattern: This wand will cause a creature to move at half its ordinary speed for 30 turns.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.text: 生物の速さを三十ターンの間、通常の半分にする魔法棒。

globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.source: This wand will render a creature temporarily invisible to the naked eye. Only with telepathy or in the silhouette of a thick gas will an observer discern the creature's hazy outline.
globalsbrogue.wandtable_brogue.this_wand.pattern: This wand will render a creature temporarily invisible to the naked eye. Only with telepathy or in the silhouette of a thick gas will an observer discern the creature's hazy outline.

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 不思議な液体は空中に浮かせ、溶岩、水、深淵、罠を簡単に越えさせる。炎、ガス、蜘蛛の巣は空中にもあるため避けられない。浮遊中は水や泥の生物から攻撃されない。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 強力で長時間続く幻覚剤。虹色の世界をさまよい、見える生物やアイテムの正体を判別できなくなる。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air. You might throw the flask at distant enemies -- or into a deep lake, to cleanse the cavern with scalding steam.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air. You might throw the flask at distant enemies -- or into a deep lake, to cleanse the cavern with scalding steam.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 外気に触れると激しく燃える不安定な化合物。遠くの敵に投げたり、深い湖に投げて洞窟を熱い蒸気で満たしたりできる。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: This mysterious brew will sensitize your mind to the radiance of magic. Items imbued with helpful enchantments will be marked with a full sigil; items corrupted by curses or designed to bring misfortune upon the bearer will be marked with a hollow sigil. The Amulet of Yendor will be revealed by its unique aura.

Items imbued with helpful enchantments will be marked with a full sigil; items corrupted by curses or designed to bring misfortune upon the bearer will be marked with a hollow sigil. globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: この薬は魔力の輝きを心で感じさせる。有益な魔法のアイテムは塗り潰した印、呪いや持ち主に害をもたらすアイテムは中空の印で示される。イェンダーの魔除けは固有の気配でわかる。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: This mysterious liquid will attune your mind to the psychic signature of distant creatures. Its effects will not reveal inanimate objects, such as totems, turrets and traps.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: This mysterious liquid will attune your mind to the psychic signature of distant creatures. Its effects will not reveal inanimate objects, such as totems, turrets and traps.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 遠くの生物の精神の気配を感じさせる液体。トーテム、砲台、罠などの無生物はわからない。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: This potion will render you impervious to heat and permit you to wander through fire and lava and ignore otherwise deadly bolts of flame. It will not guard against the concussive impact of an explosion, however.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: This potion will render you impervious to heat and permit you to wander through fire and lava and ignore otherwise deadly bolts of flame. It will not guard against the concussive impact of an explosion, however.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 熱を防ぎ、火や溶岩を歩けるようにし、致命的な火炎弾も無効にする。ただし爆発の衝撃は防げない。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: This powerful medicine will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: This powerful medicine will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: この強力な薬は筋肉に行き渡り、筋力を永続的に一点増やす。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: This unstable chemical will quickly vaporize into a glittering cloud upon contact with open air, causing any creature that inhales it to lose control of the direction of its movements until the effect wears off (although its ability to aim projectile attacks will not be affected). Its vertiginous intoxication can cause creatures and adventurers to careen into one another or into chasms or lava pits, so extreme care should be taken when under its effect. Its contents can be weaponized by throwing the flask at distant enemies.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: This unstable chemical will quickly vaporize into a glittering cloud upon contact with open air, causing any creature that inhales it to lose control of the direction of its movements until the effect wears off (although its ability to aim projectile attacks will not be affected). globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 外気に触れるときらめく雲になる不安定な薬品。吸った生物は効果が切れるまで移動の方向を制御できないが、遠距離攻撃の狙いは保てる。生物や冒険者が衝突したり、深淵や溶岩へ踏み込んだりするので細心の注意が必要。遠くの敵に投げて武器にもできる。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of caustic purple gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of caustic purple gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 栓を抜くか瓶を割ると、圧縮された中身が致命的な紫の腐食ガスとして広がる。手で開けず、遠くの敵に投げることもできる。

globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.source: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing pink haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.pattern: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing pink haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
globalsbulletbrogue.potiontable_bulletbr.text: 外気に触れると、感覚を奪う桃色の霧になる。吸った者は即座に麻痺し、雲が消えてからもしばらく動けない。遠くの敵へ投げ、ガスに巻き込める。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This ancient enchanting sorcery will imbue a single item with a powerful and permanent magical charge. A staff will increase in power and in number of charges; a weapon will inflict more damage and find its mark more easily; a suit of armor will deflect attacks more often; the magic of a ring will intensify; and a wand will gain expendable charges in the least amount that such a wand can be found with. Weapons and armor will also require less strength to use, and any curses on the item will be lifted.

Weapons and armor will also require less strength to use, and any curses on the item will be lifted.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 古い強化魔法は、一つのアイテムに強力で永続的な魔力を与える。杖は威力と充填上限が増し、武器はダメージと命中率が上がり、鎧は攻撃を弾きやすくなり、指輪の魔法は強くなる。魔法棒は発見時の最低量分の充填を得る。武器と鎧の必要筋力は減り、呪いも解ける。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your weapon against degradation by acid.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your weapon against degradation by acid.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: この儀式の保護魔法は、武器を酸による劣化から永続的に守る。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your armor against degradation by acid.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: この儀式の保護魔法は、鎧を酸による劣化から永続的に守る。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This escape spell will instantly relocate you to a random location on the dungeon level. It can be used to escape a dangerous situation with luck. The unlucky reader might find himself in an even more dangerous place.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This escape spell will instantly relocate you to a random location on the dungeon level. It can be used to escape a dangerous situation with luck. The unlucky reader might find himself in an even more dangerous place.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 迷宮の同じ階の無作為な場所へ瞬時に移す脱出魔法。幸運なら危機から逃れられるが、不運ならさらに危険な場所へ行くこともある。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This powerful scouting magic will etch a purple-hued image of crystal clarity into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all traps, secret doors and hidden levers.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This powerful scouting magic will etch a purple-hued image of crystal clarity into your memory, alerting you to the precise layout of the level and revealing all traps, secret doors and hidden levers.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: この強力な偵察魔法は、鮮明な紫の地図を記憶に刻み、この階の正確な配置とすべての罠、隠し扉、隠れたレバーを示す。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This protection rite will imbue the area with powerful warding glyphs, when released over plain ground. Monsters will not willingly set foot on the affected area.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This protection rite will imbue the area with powerful warding glyphs, when released over plain ground. Monsters will not willingly set foot on the affected area.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 普通の地面で解き放つと、周囲に強力な守護の紋様を刻む保護儀式。怪物は自らその範囲に踏み込もうとしない。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This redemption spell will instantly strip from the reader's weapon, armor, rings and carried items any evil enchantments that might prevent the wearer from removing them.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This redemption spell will instantly strip from the reader's weapon, armor, rings and carried items any evil enchantments that might prevent the wearer from removing them.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 装備を外せなくする邪悪な魔法を、武器、鎧、指輪、持ち物から瞬時に取り去る解呪魔法。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This scroll will unleash a piercing shriek that will awaken all monsters and alert them to the reader's location.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This scroll will unleash a piercing shriek that will awaken all monsters and alert them to the reader's location.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 鋭い叫びを放ち、すべての怪物を起こして読んだ者の位置を知らせる巻物。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This scroll will unleash a powerful blast of mind magic. Any creatures within line of sight will turn against their companions and attack indiscriminately for 30 turns.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This scroll will unleash a powerful blast of mind magic. Any creatures within line of sight will turn against their companions and attack indiscriminately for 30 turns.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 強力な精神魔法を放つ巻物。見える範囲の生物は仲間に敵対し、三十ターンの間、無差別に攻撃する。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This scrying magic will permanently reveal all of the secrets of a single item.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This scrying magic will permanently reveal all of the secrets of a single item.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 一つのアイテムの秘密を、永続的にすべて明らかにする透視の魔法。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This strange incantation will alter the physical structure of nearby stone, causing it to evaporate into the air over the ensuing minutes.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This strange incantation will alter the physical structure of nearby stone, causing it to evaporate into the air over the ensuing minutes.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 近くの石の構造を変え、数分の間に空気へ蒸発させる奇妙な呪文。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: This summoning incantation will call out to creatures in other planes of existence, drawing them through the fabric of reality to confront the reader.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.pattern: This summoning incantation will call out to creatures in other planes of existence, drawing them through the fabric of reality to confront the reader.
globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 異世界の生物を呼び、現実の境を越えて読んだ者に対峙させる召喚呪文。

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.source: When this powerful anti-magic is released, all creatures (including yourself) and all items lying on the ground within your field of view will be exposed to its blast and stripped of magic. Creatures animated purely by magic will die. Potions, scrolls, items being held by other creatures and items in your inventory will not be affected.

globalsbulletbrogue.scrolltable_bulletbr.text: 強力な反魔法。視野内のすべての生物（自分を含む）と地面のアイテムから魔力を奪う。魔法だけで動く生物は死ぬ。薬、巻物、生物が持つアイテム、持ち物は影響を受けない。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: The creature at the other end of this mischievous bit of cloning magic, friend or foe, will be beside itself -- literally!
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.pattern: The creature at the other end of this mischievous bit of cloning magic, friend or foe, will be beside itself -- literally!
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: いたずらな複製魔法を受けた生物は、敵でも味方でも、文字どおり自分と隣り合わせになる！

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: The force of this wand will draw the targeted creature into direct proximity.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.pattern: The force of this wand will draw the targeted creature into direct proximity.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: 標的の生物をすぐ隣まで引き寄せる魔法棒。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: This mischievous magic will transform a creature into another creature at random. Beware: the tamest of creatures might turn into the most fearsome. The horror of the transformation will turn an allied victim against you.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.pattern: This mischievous magic will transform a creature into another creature at random. Beware: the tamest of creatures might turn into the most fearsome. The horror of the transformation will turn an allied victim against you.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: 生物を無作為な別の生物に変える、いたずらな魔法。おとなしい生物が最も恐ろしいものになることもある。変身の恐怖により、味方だった標的は敵対する。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: This powerful anti-magic will strip a creature of a host of magical traits, including flight, invisibility, acidic corrosiveness, telepathy, magical speed or slowness, hypnosis, magical fear, immunity to physical attack, fire resistance and the ability to blink. Spellcasters will lose their magical abilities and magical totems will be rendered inert. Creatures animated purely by magic will die.

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: 飛行、透明化、酸の腐食性、精神感応、魔法の加速・減速、催眠、魔法の恐怖、物理攻撃への免疫、耐火、瞬間移動など、多くの特殊能力を取り去る強力な反魔法。術者は魔法能力を失い、トーテムは動かなくなる。魔法だけで動く生物は死ぬ。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: This sacred magic will permanently improve the mind and body of any monster it hits. A wise adventurer will use it on allies, making them stronger in combat and able to learn a new talent from a fallen foe. If the bolt is reflected back at you, it will have no effect.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.pattern: This sacred magic will permanently improve the mind and body of any monster it hits. globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: 命中した怪物の心身を永続的に強化する聖なる魔法。賢い冒険者は味方に使い、戦闘力を高め、倒した敵から新しい能力を一つ学べるようにする。自分へ反射されても効果はない。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: This wand can forever bind an enemy to the caster's will, turning it into a steadfast ally. However, the magic only works effectively against enemies that are near death.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.pattern: This wand can forever bind an enemy to the caster's will, turning it into a steadfast ally. However, the magic only works effectively against enemies that are near death.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: 敵を永続的に従え、忠実な味方にする魔法棒。ただし死にかけの敵にしか有効に働かない。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: This wand will cause a creature to move at half its ordinary speed for 30 turns.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.pattern: This wand will cause a creature to move at half its ordinary speed for 30 turns.
globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.text: 生物の速さを三十ターンの間、通常の半分にする魔法棒。

globalsbulletbrogue.wandtable_bulletbrog.source: This wand will render a creature temporarily invisible to the naked eye. Only with telepathy or in the silhouette of a thick gas will an observer discern the creature's hazy outline.

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This curious liquid will cause you to hover in the air, able to drift effortlessly over lava, water, chasms and traps. Flames, gases and spiderwebs fill the air, and cannot be bypassed while airborne. Creatures that dwell in water or mud will be unable to attack you while you levitate.

Flames, gases and spiderwebs fill the air, and cannot be bypassed while airborne. Creatures that dwell in water or mud will be unable to attack you while you levitate.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 不思議な液体は空中に浮かせ、溶岩、水、深淵、罠を簡単に越えさせる。炎、ガス、蜘蛛の巣は空中にもあるため避けられない。浮遊中は水や泥の生物から攻撃されない。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This flask contains a vicious and long-lasting hallucinogen. Under its dazzling effect, you will wander through a rainbow wonderland, unable to discern the form of any creatures or items you see.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This flask contains a vicious and long-lasting hallucinogen. Under its dazzling effect, you will wander through a rainbow wonderland, unable to discern the form of any creatures or items you see.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 強力で長時間続く幻覚剤。虹色の世界をさまよい、見える生物やアイテムの正体を判別できなくなる。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air. You might throw the flask at distant enemies -- or into a deep lake, to cleanse the cavern with scalding steam.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This flask contains an unstable compound which will burst violently into flame upon exposure to open air. You might throw the flask at distant enemies -- or into a deep lake, to cleanse the cavern with scalding steam.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 外気に触れると激しく燃える不安定な化合物。遠くの敵に投げたり、深い湖に投げて洞窟を熱い蒸気で満たしたりできる。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This mysterious brew will sensitize your mind to the radiance of magic. Items imbued with helpful enchantments will be marked with a full sigil; items corrupted by curses or designed to bring misfortune upon the bearer will be marked with a hollow sigil. The Amulet of Yendor will be revealed by its unique aura.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This mysterious brew will sensitize your mind to the radiance of magic. Items imbued with helpful enchantments will be marked with a full sigil; items corrupted by curses or designed to bring misfortune upon the bearer will be marked with a hollow sigil. The Amulet of Yendor will be revealed by its unique aura.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: この薬は魔力の輝きを心で感じさせる。有益な魔法のアイテムは塗り潰した印、呪いや持ち主に害をもたらすアイテムは中空の印で示される。イェンダーの魔除けは固有の気配でわかる。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This mysterious liquid will attune your mind to the psychic signature of distant creatures. Its effects will not reveal inanimate objects, such as totems, turrets and traps.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This mysterious liquid will attune your mind to the psychic signature of distant creatures. Its effects will not reveal inanimate objects, such as totems, turrets and traps.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 遠くの生物の精神の気配を感じさせる液体。トーテム、砲台、罠などの無生物はわからない。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This potion will render you impervious to heat and permit you to wander through fire and lava and ignore otherwise deadly bolts of flame. It will not guard against the concussive impact of an explosion, however.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This potion will render you impervious to heat and permit you to wander through fire and lava and ignore otherwise deadly bolts of flame. It will not guard against the concussive impact of an explosion, however.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 熱を防ぎ、火や溶岩を歩けるようにし、致命的な火炎弾も無効にする。ただし爆発の衝撃は防げない。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This powerful medicine will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This powerful medicine will course through your muscles, permanently increasing your strength by one point.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: この強力な薬は筋肉に行き渡り、筋力を永続的に一点増やす。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: This unstable chemical will quickly vaporize into a glittering cloud upon contact with open air, causing any creature that inhales it to lose control of the direction of its movements until the effect wears off (although its ability to aim projectile attacks will not be affected). Its vertiginous intoxication can cause creatures and adventurers to careen into one another or into chasms or lava pits, so extreme care should be taken when under its effect. Its contents can be weaponized by throwing the flask at distant enemies.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: This unstable chemical will quickly vaporize into a glittering cloud upon contact with open air, causing any creature that inhales it to lose control of the direction of its movements until the effect wears off (although its ability to aim projectile attacks will not be affected). Its vertiginous intoxication can cause creatures and adventurers to careen into one another or into chasms or lava pits, so extreme care should be taken when under its effect. Its contents can be weaponized by throwing the flask at distant enemies.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 外気に触れるときらめく雲になる不安定な薬品。吸った生物は効果が切れるまで移動の方向を制御できないが、遠距離攻撃の狙いは保てる。生物や冒険者が衝突したり、深淵や溶岩へ踏み込んだりするので細心の注意が必要。遠くの敵に投げて武器にもできる。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of caustic purple gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: Uncorking or shattering this pressurized glass will cause its contents to explode into a deadly cloud of caustic purple gas. You might choose to fling this potion at distant enemies instead of uncorking it by hand.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 栓を抜くか瓶を割ると、圧縮された中身が致命的な紫の腐食ガスとして広がる。手で開けず、遠くの敵に投げることもできる。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing pink haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: Upon exposure to open air, the liquid in this flask will vaporize into a numbing pink haze. Anyone who inhales the cloud will be paralyzed instantly, unable to move for some time after the cloud dissipates. This item can be thrown at distant enemies to catch them within the effect of the gas.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 外気に触れると、感覚を奪う桃色の霧になる。吸った者は即座に麻痺し、雲が消えてからもしばらく動けない。遠くの敵へ投げ、ガスに巻き込める。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: When the cork is popped or the flask is thrown, tiny spores will spill across the ground and begin to grow a deadly lichen. Anything that touches the lichen will be poisoned by its clinging tendrils, and the lichen will slowly grow to fill the area. Fire will purge the infestation.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: When the cork is popped or the flask is thrown, tiny spores will spill across the ground and begin to grow a deadly lichen. Anything that touches the lichen will be poisoned by its clinging tendrils, and the lichen will slowly grow to fill the area. Fire will purge the infestation.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 栓を抜くか投げて割ると、小さな胞子が地面に広がり、致命的な地衣が生える。接触したものは蔓で毒を受け、地衣はゆっくり周囲へ広がる。火で除去できる。

globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.source: When this flask is uncorked by hand or shattered by being thrown, the fog that seeps out will temporarily cause the ground in the vicinity to vanish.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.pattern: When this flask is uncorked by hand or shattered by being thrown, the fog that seeps out will temporarily cause the ground in the vicinity to vanish.
globalsrapidbrogue.potiontable_rapidbrog.text: 手で栓を抜くか投げて割ると、漏れ出す霧が周囲の地面を一時的に消す。

globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.pattern: The power bound up in this parchment will instantly recharge all of your staffs and charms.
globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.text: この羊皮紙に宿る力は、すべての杖とお守りを瞬時に再充填する。

globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.source: This ancient enchanting sorcery will imbue a single item with a powerful and permanent magical charge. A staff will increase in power and in number of charges; a weapon will inflict more damage and find its mark more easily; a suit of armor will deflect attacks more often; the magic of a ring will intensify; and a wand will gain expendable charges in the least amount that such a wand can be found with. Weapons and armor will also require less strength to use, and any curses on the item will be lifted.
globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.pattern: This ancient enchanting sorcery will imbue a single item with a powerful and permanent magical charge. A staff will increase in power and in number of charges; a weapon will inflict more damage and find its mark more easily; a suit of armor will deflect attacks more often; the magic of a ring will intensify; and a wand will gain expendable charges in the least amount that such a wand can be found with. Weapons and armor will also require less strength to use, and any curses on the item will be lifted.
globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.text: 古い強化魔法は、一つのアイテムに強力で永続的な魔力を与える。杖は威力と充填上限が増し、武器はダメージと命中率が上がり、鎧は攻撃を弾きやすくなり、指輪の魔法は強くなる。魔法棒は発見時の最低量分の充填を得る。武器と鎧の必要筋力は減り、呪いも解ける。

globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.source: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your weapon against degradation by acid.
globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.pattern: This ceremonial shielding magic will permanently proof your weapon against degradation by acid.
globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.text: この儀式の保護魔法は、武器を酸による劣化から永続的に守る。

globalsrapidbrogue.scrolltable_rapidbrog.text: この儀式の保護魔法は、鎧を酸による劣化から永続的に守る。
